guide.summary: A particle at the very end of a sentence does not change what happened; it tells the listener how to take the sentence: a yes/no question (吗), 'and what about...?' or 'still going on' (呢), a suggestion or a guess (吧), warmth (啊), 'obviously' (嘛, 呗), 'I assure you' (的), 'things are different now' (了). Decide what the speaker is doing to the listener, then pick the particle.

subs.label: 吗 yes/no question
subs.focus: Decide whether 吗 belongs at all. It makes a statement a neutral yes/no question and must be left out (∅) when the sentence has a question word asking for information, verb-不-verb, or 还是. Classic errors: 你去哪儿吗, 你喝不喝茶吗. Also 吗 vs 吧 when the English is a neutral question with no guess.

subs.label: 呢 in questions
subs.focus: (1) Noun + 呢 = 'and you? / what about X? / where is X?' (你呢? 我的手机呢?); the error is 你吗. (2) 呢, never 吗, softens a question that is already one (question word, A-not-A, 还是). 呢 cannot make a statement a yes/no question: 你是学生呢 is wrong.

subs.label: 呢 for 'still the case'
subs.focus: Statement 呢 = this is how things stand right now, often against the listener's assumption: 在 + verb + 呢, verb + 着 + 呢, 还没...呢, 才...呢. Force 呢 against 了, 吗, 吧 with a clue word (在, 正在, 着, 还没, 才). Classic error: 我还没吃饭了.

subs.label: 吧 suggestion or soft command
subs.focus: 吧 after an action = 'let's', 'why don't you', a softened instruction; 好吧 / 行吧 gives in. The English cue is a proposal or gentle request, not a question of fact. Force 吧 over 吗 (asks if it is true), 了 and 呢. Classic error: 我们走吗 for 'Let's go'.

subs.label: 吧 'I suppose..., right?'
subs.focus: 吧 on a statement = the speaker already believes it and wants agreement (你是老师吧?). English cues: 'right?', 'you must be', 'I suppose', 'probably'. Separate from neutral 吗 by the English; 大概, 应该, 一定 point to 吧. Never 吧吗, never 吧 on a question-word question.

subs.label: 啊 warmth and exclamation
subs.focus: 啊 adds feeling without changing the sentence type: exclamation (真好啊, 多漂亮啊), warm agreement (是啊, 好啊), friendly urging (快来啊). English cue has an exclamation or clearly warm tone. Distractors: 吗 (makes a yes/no question), 吧 (a guess), 呢. 啊 never creates a yes/no question.

subs.label: 嘛 and 呗 'obviously'
subs.focus: 嘛 = 'obviously, after all, you should know' and never asks; the trap is writing 吗, which makes a question. 呗 = 'simple: just do it / so be it', usually ...就...呗, with a shrug. English cues: 'after all', 'of course', 'just ... then', 'so what'. Force 嘛 or 呗 against 吗, 吧, 呢.

subs.label: 的 assurance
subs.focus: Final 的 after 会 / 不会 / 一定会 = calm promise or reassurance about the future (会好的, 他会来的). Force 的 over 了 (announces a change). 吧 after 一定会 is a natural guess: never a wrong option. English cues: 'don't worry', 'I promise', 'is sure to'. Not the 是...的 past-detail pattern.

subs.label: 了 change of state
subs.focus: Final 了 = the situation is new, not so before (下雨了, 我饿了, 我不去了, 他是大学生了). English cues: 'now', 'not any more', 'has become'. Force 了 against 呢 (still the same), 的 (assurance) and ∅ (plain description). Classic error: dropping 了 from 不...了 'not any more'.

rules.rule: Put 吗 at the end of a statement to ask a neutral yes/no question. Nothing else in the sentence moves.

examples.py: nǐ shì xué sheng ma
examples.en: Are you a student?

examples.py: nǐ míng tiān yǒu shí jiān ma
examples.en: Do you have time tomorrow?

examples.py: tā bù xǐ huan chī là de ma
examples.en: Doesn't he like spicy food?

rules.rule: A sentence that is already a question takes no 吗: not with a question word (谁, 什么, 哪儿, 怎么, 几, 多少), not with verb-不-verb or 有没有, not with 还是.
rules.pattern: Question word / Verb + 不 + Verb / A + 还是 + B + (no 吗)

examples.py: nǐ xiǎng hē shén me
examples.en: What would you like to drink?

examples.py: nǐ míng tiān lái bù lái
examples.en: Are you coming tomorrow or not?

examples.py: nǐ zuò huǒ chē hái shi zuò fēi jī
examples.en: Are you taking the train or the plane?

rules.note: One real exception: when 什么 or 谁 means 'something / anyone' rather than asking for information, the sentence is a yes/no question and 吗 is fine: 你想喝点什么吗? (Would you like something to drink?).

rules.rule: Noun or pronoun + 呢 asks the question that is already in the air about someone or something else: 'and you?', 'what about...?'. With no earlier question it asks 'where is...?'.

examples.py: wǒ hěn hǎo nǐ ne
examples.en: I'm fine. And you?

examples.py: wǒ hē chá nǐ ne
examples.en: I'll have tea. What about you?

examples.py: jīn tiān méi shí jiān míng tiān ne
examples.en: There's no time today. How about tomorrow?

examples.py: wǒ de shǒu jī ne
examples.en: Where's my phone?

rules.rule: 呢 can be added to a question that is already a question (question word, verb-不-verb, 还是) to make it sound thoughtful or less blunt. It cannot turn a statement into a yes/no question; that is the job of 吗.
rules.pattern: Question-word question / A-not-A question / 还是 question + 呢

examples.py: tā wèi shén me bù lái ne
examples.en: Why isn't he coming, I wonder?

examples.py: wǒ men zěn me qù ne
examples.en: So how shall we get there?

examples.py: nǐ dào dǐ qù bù qù ne
examples.en: So are you going or not?

rules.note: This 呢 is optional: the question is complete without it. In drills it is the right choice only because 吗 is impossible after these question forms.

rules.rule: On a statement, 呢 says 'this is how things stand right now', often correcting what the listener assumes. It goes with 在 / 正在 + verb, verb + 着, 还没 (not yet), and 才 (only / certainly not).
rules.pattern: (正)在 + Verb + 呢 / Verb + 着 + 呢 / 还没 + Verb + 呢 / 才 + ... + 呢

examples.py: bié shuō huà hái zi zài shuì jiào ne
examples.en: Don't talk, the child is sleeping.

examples.py: wài miàn xià zhe yǔ ne
examples.en: It's raining outside (you know).

examples.py: wǒ hái méi chī fàn ne
examples.en: I haven't eaten yet.

examples.py: xiàn zài cái bā diǎn ne
examples.en: It's only eight o'clock.

rules.note: 还没 never takes 了, because nothing has happened or changed yet. 才...呢 can also push back strongly: 我才不去呢 (I'm certainly not going).

rules.rule: 吧 after an action makes a suggestion ('let's', 'why don't you') or softens a command so it is not an order. 好吧 and 行吧 mean 'all right then', giving in.

examples.py: wǒ men zǒu ba
examples.en: Let's go.

examples.py: nǐ xiān xiū xi yī xià ba
examples.en: Why don't you rest for a bit first.

examples.py: tài wǎn le míng tiān zài shuō ba
examples.en: It's too late; let's talk about it tomorrow.

examples.py: hǎo ba wǒ gēn nǐ yī qǐ qù
examples.en: All right then, I'll go with you.

rules.rule: 吧 on a statement shows you already believe it and want the listener to confirm: 'you are..., right?', 'I suppose...'. With 吗 you have no opinion; with 吧 you are guessing yes.

examples.py: nǐ shì lǎo shī ba
examples.en: You're a teacher, right?

examples.py: nǐ men yǐ jīng rèn shi le ba
examples.en: You two already know each other, I take it?

examples.py: tā jīn tiān dà gài bù lái le ba
examples.en: He's probably not coming today, I suppose.

rules.note: Never combine 吧 with 吗. A guess with 吧 may be written with a question mark or a full stop, depending on how much the speaker expects an answer.

rules.rule: 啊 adds feeling and friendliness without changing the sentence type: it marks an exclamation (often with 真, 多, 好), warm agreement, or friendly urging. It does not make a yes/no question.
rules.pattern: 真 / 多 / 好 + Adjective + 啊 ; Sentence + 啊

examples.py: jīn tiān tiān qì zhēn hǎo a
examples.en: The weather is so nice today!

examples.py: zhè r de fēng jǐng duō piào liang a
examples.en: How beautiful the scenery here is!

examples.py: shì a wǒ yě zhè me xiǎng
examples.en: Yes, exactly, I think so too.

examples.py: kuài lái a diàn yǐng yào kāi shǐ le
examples.en: Come on, hurry, the film is about to start!

rules.note: In speech 啊 blends with the sound before it and is then often written 呀 (after a, e, i, o, ü: 是你呀, 快来呀), 哇 (after u, ao: 好哇) or 哪 (after n: 天哪). These are the same particle; writing 啊 is always acceptable. 啊 can also make a question-word question friendlier: 你去哪儿啊?

rules.rule: 嘛 says the fact is obvious and the listener should already know it: 'after all', 'of course', 'come on'. It sounds like 吗 but is a different word and never asks a question.

examples.py: tā hái shi hái zi ma bié shēng qì
examples.en: He's still a child, after all; don't be angry.

examples.py: zhè ge wèn tí hěn jiǎn dān ma
examples.en: This question is easy, obviously.

examples.py: wǒ zǎo jiù gào su nǐ le ma
examples.en: I told you long ago, didn't I.

rules.note: After a request, 嘛 coaxes rather than states the obvious: 你就去嘛 (Oh, go on, just go).

rules.rule: 呗 says the answer is simple and not worth worrying about: 'just ... then', 'so be it'. It is casual, comes with a shrug, and most often closes a ...就... sentence.

examples.py: bù huì jiù xué bei
examples.en: If you can't do it, just learn, then.

examples.py: nǐ xiǎng qù jiù qù bei
examples.en: If you want to go, just go.

examples.py: tā bù lái jiù bù lái bei
examples.en: If he's not coming, then he's not coming. So what.

rules.note: 呗 is informal and can sound careless; it is for friends, not for polite requests. Where 吧 would propose something gently, 呗 treats it as the obvious thing to do.

rules.rule: 会 ... 的 gives a calm assurance or promise about the future: 'it will, believe me'. Use 的, not 了, at the end.
rules.pattern: Subject + (一定) + (不) + 会 + Verb / Adjective + 的

examples.py: bié dān xīn huì hǎo de
examples.en: Don't worry, it will be all right.

examples.py: tā yī dìng huì lái de
examples.en: He will definitely come.

examples.py: wǒ bù huì gào su bié rén de
examples.en: I won't tell anyone, I promise.

rules.note: Without 的 the sentence is still correct (他会来) but is a plain prediction; 的 adds the speaker's certainty.

rules.rule: 了 at the end of a sentence says the situation is new: it is so now and was not before. With 不 it means 'not any more' or a changed plan.
rules.pattern: Sentence + 了 ; 不 + Verb + 了

examples.py: xià yǔ le kuài jìn lái ba
examples.en: It's started raining; come in quickly.

examples.py: wǒ è le wǒ men qù chī fàn ba
examples.en: I'm hungry now; let's go and eat.

examples.py: wǒ bù xiǎng qù le
examples.en: I don't want to go any more.

examples.py: tā xiàn zài shì dà xué shēng le
examples.en: She's a university student now.

rules.note: Compare with 呢: 他在睡觉呢 = he is (still) asleep; 他睡觉了 = he has gone to bed (new situation). Verb-了 for completed actions is covered in the 了 topic.

contrasts.why: 哪儿 already makes the sentence a question. 吗 is only for turning a statement into a yes/no question.
喝不喝 is the question. Use verb-不-verb or 吗, not both.

right.py: nǐ hē chá hái shi hē kā fēi
right.en: Will you have tea or coffee?

contrasts.why: 还是 asks the listener to choose, so the sentence is already a question and cannot take 吗.

right.py: wǒ shì shàng hǎi rén nǐ ne

contrasts.why: 'And you?' bounces the same question back, which is noun + 呢. 吗 needs a full statement in front of it.
呢 cannot turn a statement into a yes/no question. It only follows a bare noun or a sentence that is already a question.

right.py: shí jiān bù zǎo le wǒ men zǒu ba

contrasts.why: 'Let's' is a suggestion, which is 吧. 我们走吗? would ask 'Are we leaving?' instead of proposing it.

right.py: wǒ hái méi chī fàn ne

contrasts.why: 还没 means nothing has changed yet, so 了 is impossible. 呢 marks 'still the case'.

right.py: bié zháo jí tā yī dìng huì lái de
right.en: Don't worry, he will definitely come.

contrasts.why: Reassurance about the future is 会...的. 了 reports a change that has happened and does not fit 一定会.

right.py: tā shì hái zi ma bié shēng qì le
right.en: He's a child, after all; don't be angry any more.

contrasts.why: The speaker is stating something obvious, not asking. That is 嘛; 吗 would turn it into 'Is he a child?'.

right.py: wǒ yǐ jīng bù hē kā fēi le
right.en: I don't drink coffee any more.

contrasts.why: 'Not any more' is a change from before, so the sentence needs 了 at the end: 不 + verb + 了. With 已经 the 了 cannot be dropped.

cheat: Question word, verb-不-verb or 还是 in the sentence? No 吗. Only 呢 or 啊 can be added.
'And you? / What about X? / Where's X?' = noun + 呢.
Neutral yes/no = 吗. 'Right? / I suppose / must be' = 吧. Never both.
'Let's... / Why don't you... / All right then' = 吧.
在, 正在, 着, 还没 or 才 in the sentence and things are still that way = 呢. Different from before, 'now', 'not any more' = 了.
'Don't worry, it will' = 会...的. 'After all, obviously' = 嘛 (not 吗). 'Just do it then, so what' = 就...呗.
Exclamation with 真 / 多 / 好, or a warm 'yes!' or 'come on!' = 啊.

items.q: 你们先去教室___，我马上就来。
items.zh: 你们先去教室吧，我马上就来。
items.py: nǐ men xiān qù jiào shì ba wǒ mǎ shàng jiù lái
items.en: You go to the classroom first; I'll be right there.
items.why: 吧 softens the instruction. 吗 would ask whether they are going, and the speaker is telling them what to do.

items.q: 太晚了，我们回家___。
items.zh: 太晚了，我们回家吧。
items.py: tài wǎn le wǒ men huí jiā ba
items.en: It's too late; let's go home.
items.why: 'Let's...' is a suggestion, which is 吧. 吗 would ask 'Are we going home?', and 呢 and 的 make no proposal.

items.task: Reassure the listener: he will definitely come.
items.zh: 他明天一定会来的。
items.py: tā míng tiān yī dìng huì lái de
items.en: He will definitely come tomorrow.
items.why: 一定会...的 turns a plain prediction into a firm assurance; 了 would announce a change instead.

items.s: 他还是孩子嘛，别太严格。
items.zh: 他还是孩子嘛，别太严格。
items.py: tā hái shi hái zi ma bié tài yán gé
items.en: He's still a child, after all; don't be too strict.
items.why: 嘛 states the obvious and does not ask. It is a different word from 吗, though they sound the same.

items.s_py: nǐ xiān zuò xià ma wǒ qù ná shuǐ
items.zh: 你先坐下吧，我去拿水。
items.py: nǐ xiān zuò xià ba wǒ qù ná shuǐ
items.en: Sit down first; I'll go and get some water.
items.why: A soft instruction takes 吧. 吗 only forms a question, and the sentence is not asking anything.

items.zh: 你不会是生气了吧？
items.py: nǐ bù huì shì shēng qì le ba
items.en: You're not angry, are you?
items.why: 不会是...吧 is a fixed way to voice a worried guess while hoping it is not so. 了 before 吧 is correct because it says you have become angry, a new state.

items.q: 我才不去___！那个会太无聊了。
items.zh: 我才不去呢！那个会太无聊了。
items.py: wǒ cái bù qù ne nà ge huì tài wú liáo le
items.en: I'm certainly not going! That meeting is too boring.
items.why: 才不...呢 is the pattern for a firm refusal. 吗 would turn it into a question and 吧 would soften it into a vague guess.

items.zh: 这个办公室多安静啊！
items.py: zhè ge bàn gōng shì duō ān jìng a
items.en: How quiet this office is!
items.why: The exclamation 多 + adjective ends with 啊, which carries the feeling.

items.s_py: nǐ de xīn jiā duō piào liang ma
items.zh: 你的新家多漂亮啊！
items.py: nǐ de xīn jiā duō piào liang a
items.en: How beautiful your new home is!
items.why: 多 + adjective is an exclamation, which takes 啊. 吗 makes a yes/no question and cannot end an exclamation.

items.q: 我不知道你的安排，你明天要上班___？
items.zh: 我不知道你的安排，你明天要上班吗？
items.py: wǒ bù zhī dào nǐ de ān pái nǐ míng tiān yào shàng bān ma
items.en: I don't know your schedule. Do you have to work tomorrow?
items.why: The speaker has no guess, so this is a neutral yes/no question: 吗. 吧 would mean 'you have to work tomorrow, right?', which contradicts 我不知道.

items.q: 妈妈正在做饭___，你别进厨房。
items.zh: 妈妈正在做饭呢，你别进厨房。
items.py: mā ma zhèng zài zuò fàn ne nǐ bié jìn chú fáng
items.en: Mum is cooking right now; don't go into the kitchen.
items.why: 正在 + verb + 呢 describes what is going on at this moment. 了 would report that cooking has started or finished, and 吗 or 吧 do not state a fact.

items.q: 请问，你们学校有图书馆___？
items.zh: 请问，你们学校有图书馆吗？
items.py: qǐng wèn nǐ men xué xiào yǒu tú shū guǎn ma
items.en: Excuse me, does your school have a library?
items.why: A plain statement becomes a neutral yes/no question with 吗 at the end. 呢 needs a bare noun or an existing question, and 的 does not ask anything.

items.q: 你放心，我保证不会把这件事告诉别人___。
items.zh: 你放心，我保证不会把这件事告诉别人的。
items.py: nǐ fàng xīn wǒ bǎo zhèng bù huì bǎ zhè jiàn shì gào su bié rén de
items.en: Rest assured, I promise I won't tell anyone about this.
items.why: 保证 + 不会...的 is a firm promise. 了 does not fit a future promise, and 吧 would make the promise tentative.

items.s_py: wǒ shì zhōng guó rén nǐ ma
items.zh: 我是中国人，你呢？
items.py: wǒ shì zhōng guó rén nǐ ne
items.en: I'm Chinese. And you?
items.why: 'And you?' is bare pronoun + 呢. 吗 needs a full statement, so 你吗 cannot bounce the question back.

items.q: 老师说这次考试的成绩还没公布___，大家先不要着急。
items.zh: 老师说这次考试的成绩还没公布呢，大家先不要着急。
items.py: lǎo shī shuō zhè cì kǎo shì de chéng jì hái méi gōng bù ne dà jiā xiān bù yào zháo jí
items.en: The teacher said the exam results haven't been announced yet, so everyone shouldn't worry for now.
items.why: 还没公布 describes a situation that has not changed, so 呢 fits and 了 does not. 吗 would ask and the sentence is a report.

items.q: 他还是个孩子___，别生气。
items.zh: 他还是个孩子嘛，别生气。
items.py: tā hái shi ge hái zi ma bié shēng qì
items.en: He's still a child, after all; don't be angry.
items.why: 嘛 says 'obviously, after all' and asks nothing. 吗 would make it 'Is he still a child?', which contradicts the plea that follows.

items.q: 你先坐___，我去倒茶。
items.zh: 你先坐吧，我去倒茶。
items.py: nǐ xiān zuò ba wǒ qù dào chá
items.en: Have a seat first; I'll go and pour some tea.
items.why: 吧 softens an instruction into a polite invitation. 吗 would ask whether the person sits, and 呢 or 了 do not invite.

items.q: 你唱得多好___！大家都喜欢听。
items.zh: 你唱得多好啊！大家都喜欢听。
items.py: nǐ chàng de duō hǎo a dà jiā dōu xǐ huan tīng
items.en: How well you sing! Everyone loves to listen.
items.why: The exclamation 多好 takes 啊 for warmth. 吗 would ask whether the singing is good, which does not fit the following praise.

items.s: 现在才六点呢，天还没亮。
items.zh: 现在才六点呢，天还没亮。
items.py: xiàn zài cái liù diǎn ne tiān hái méi liàng
items.en: It's only six o'clock; it isn't light yet.
items.why: 才...呢 marks 'only'. Ending with 呢 rather than 了 is right because nothing has changed yet.

items.zh: 好吧，那我明天再来。
items.py: hǎo ba nà wǒ míng tiān zài lái
items.en: All right then, I'll come again tomorrow.
items.why: 好吧 is a reluctant 'all right then'. The particle is 吧, not 吗, because the speaker is giving in rather than asking.

items.q: 这次旅行能认识这么多新朋友，我真高兴___！
items.zh: 这次旅行能认识这么多新朋友，我真高兴啊！
items.py: zhè cì lǚ xíng néng rèn shi zhè me duō xīn péng you wǒ zhēn gāo xìng a
items.en: I'm so happy to have met so many new friends on this trip!
items.why: 真高兴 is an exclamation of feeling, so 啊. 吗 would ask whether the speaker is happy, and 吧 would hedge it.

items.q: 你们的会议室在几楼___？
items.zh: 你们的会议室在几楼？
items.py: nǐ men de huì yì shì zài jǐ lóu
items.en: Which floor is your meeting room on?
items.why: 几楼 is a question word, so the sentence is already a question and takes no 吗. 吗 is only added to a statement.

items.q: 你想看就看___，我不管。
items.zh: 你想看就看呗，我不管。
items.py: nǐ xiǎng kàn jiù kàn bei wǒ bù guǎn
items.en: If you want to watch it, just watch it, then; I don't care.
items.why: ...就...呗 says 'just do it then', with a shrug, and fits 我不管. 吗 would ask a question and 呢 states an ongoing situation.

items.q: 你们俩应该早就认识了___？
items.zh: 你们俩应该早就认识了吧？
items.py: nǐ men liǎ yīng gāi zǎo jiù rèn shi le ba
items.en: You two must have known each other for ages, I take it?
items.why: 应该 expresses an expectation, so 吧 asks for agreement. 吗 would be a neutral question and does not fit 应该.

items.q: 他为什么还不来___？
items.zh: 他为什么还不来呢？
items.py: tā wèi shén me hái bù lái ne
items.en: Why isn't he here yet, I wonder?
items.why: 为什么 makes this a question, so 吗 cannot follow. 呢 softens it to 'I wonder why'; 了 would clash with 还不 (not yet).

items.q: 多好的老师___！大家都很喜欢他。
items.zh: 多好的老师啊！大家都很喜欢他。
items.py: duō hǎo de lǎo shī a dà jiā dōu hěn xǐ huan tā
items.en: What a good teacher! Everyone likes him.
items.why: 多 + adjective + 的 + noun + 啊 is an exclamation. 吗 would ask and 了 reports a change, neither of which fits the praise.

items.q: 我们班有三十个人，你们班___？
items.zh: 我们班有三十个人，你们班呢？
items.py: wǒ men bān yǒu sān shí ge rén nǐ men bān ne
items.en: Our class has thirty people. What about yours?
items.why: After a statement about one thing, noun + 呢 asks the same about another: 'and yours?'. 吗 would need a full clause such as 你们班有三十个人吗.

items.q: 如果你觉得这份工作太累，就换一份轻松一些的___。
items.zh: 如果你觉得这份工作太累，就换一份轻松一些的吧。
items.py: rú guǒ nǐ jué de zhè fèn gōng zuò tài lèi jiù huàn yī fèn qīng sōng yī xiē de ba
items.en: If you find this job too tiring, why not switch to a more relaxed one?
items.why: 吧 turns the advice 就换... into a gentle suggestion. 吗 would ask whether the listener will switch and 呢 states a situation.

items.q: 小声一点，弟弟还在睡觉___。
items.zh: 小声一点，弟弟还在睡觉呢。
items.py: xiǎo shēng yī diǎn dì di hái zài shuì jiào ne
items.en: Keep it down; my little brother is still sleeping.
items.why: 还在 + verb marks something still going on, and 呢 stresses that state. 了 would announce a new situation, and 吗 would ask.

items.zh: 你一定会成功的。
items.py: nǐ yī dìng huì chéng gōng de
items.en: You will surely succeed.
items.why: 一定会...的 is the assurance frame: the adverb before 会 and 的 closes the sentence.

items.q: 我已经不喝咖啡___，医生说对身体不好。
items.zh: 我已经不喝咖啡了，医生说对身体不好。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng bù hē kā fēi le yī shēng shuō duì shēn tǐ bù hǎo
items.en: I don't drink coffee any more; the doctor said it's bad for my health.
items.why: 已经不...了 means 'not any more'. 吗 would turn it into a question, and 呢 would say that I am still not drinking it as before.

items.q: 你看，他已经比我高___！
items.zh: 你看，他已经比我高了！
items.py: nǐ kàn tā yǐ jīng bǐ wǒ gāo le
items.en: Look, he's taller than me already!
items.why: 已经 ... 了 reports a new state: he was not taller before. 吗 would ask and 吧 would guess at something the speaker can see.

items.q: 今天天气真好___！
items.zh: 今天天气真好啊！
items.py: jīn tiān tiān qì zhēn hǎo a
items.en: The weather is so nice today!
items.why: 真 + adjective is an exclamation and 啊 adds the feeling. 吗 would turn it into a question and 吧 into a guess.

items.q: 只要努力学习，你一定会考上大学___。
items.zh: 只要努力学习，你一定会考上大学的。
items.py: zhǐ yào nǔ lì xué xí nǐ yī dìng huì kǎo shàng dà xué de
items.en: As long as you study hard, you'll surely get into university.
items.why: A confident promise about the future: 一定会...的. 了 would announce a change that has already happened, and 吗 would turn the reassurance into a question.

items.zh: 我不想去了，你们去吧。
items.py: wǒ bù xiǎng qù le nǐ men qù ba
items.en: I don't want to go any more; you go.
items.why: 不...了 means 'not any more', so 了 is needed. 吧 then softens the instruction to the others.

items.task: Say you haven't eaten yet (still the case).
items.zh: 我还没吃饭呢。
items.py: wǒ hái méi chī fàn ne
items.en: I haven't eaten yet.
items.why: 还没 + verb + 呢 means 'not yet'; 了 cannot be added because nothing has happened.

items.q: 春天到___，花都开了。
items.zh: 春天到了，花都开了。
items.py: chūn tiān dào le huā dōu kāi le
items.en: Spring has arrived; the flowers are all in bloom.
items.why: 春天到了 reports that a new season has begun. 呢 would say it is still on the way, and 吗 or 吧 would not report a fact.

items.zh: 我们一起去图书馆吧。
items.py: wǒ men yī qǐ qù tú shū guǎn ba
items.en: Let's go to the library together.
items.why: 吧 closes the suggestion at the end; 一起 comes before the verb 去.

items.q: 我不会忘记今天的会议___，你放心。
items.zh: 我不会忘记今天的会议的，你放心。
items.py: wǒ bù huì wàng jì jīn tiān de huì yì de nǐ fàng xīn
items.en: I won't forget today's meeting; rest assured.
items.why: 不会...的 is a promise with 你放心 as support. 吧 would make it a shaky guess, and 了 would announce a change.

items.q: 你的作业写完了就去休息___。
items.zh: 你的作业写完了就去休息吧。
items.py: nǐ de zuò yè xiě wán le jiù qù xiū xi ba
items.en: Once your homework is done, go and rest.
items.why: 吧 turns a command into a kind instruction. 吗 would ask whether the listener will rest, which is not what the speaker means.

items.q: 经理正在开会___，你下午再来吧。
items.zh: 经理正在开会呢，你下午再来吧。
items.py: jīng lǐ zhèng zài kāi huì ne nǐ xià wǔ zài lái ba
items.en: The manager is in a meeting right now; come back this afternoon.
items.why: 正在 marks an action in progress, and 呢 closes it as 'this is how things stand'. 了 would mean the meeting has ended or started as news.

items.s: 冬天到呢，我们要多穿衣服。
items.s_py: dōng tiān dào ne wǒ men yào duō chuān yī fu
items.zh: 冬天到了，我们要多穿衣服。
items.py: dōng tiān dào le wǒ men yào duō chuān yī fu
items.en: Winter has arrived; we need to wear more clothes.
items.why: A season arriving is a new situation, which takes 了. 呢 marks a continuing state and cannot follow 到 here.

items.q: 你一定是李老师___？
items.zh: 你一定是李老师吧？
items.py: nǐ yī dìng shì lǐ lǎo shī ba
items.en: You must be Teacher Li.
items.why: 一定 shows the speaker is already sure and wants a nod: 吧. 吗 asks with no opinion and clashes with 一定.

items.q: 别难过，这次没考好没关系，下次你一定会成功___。
items.zh: 别难过，这次没考好没关系，下次你一定会成功的。
items.py: bié nán guò zhè cì méi kǎo hǎo méi guān xi xià cì nǐ yī dìng huì chéng gōng de
items.en: Don't be sad; it doesn't matter that you didn't do well this time. You'll surely succeed next time.
items.why: The speaker comforts with certainty: 一定会...的. 了 is for things that have changed, and 吗 turns comfort into a question.

items.q: 时间不早了，大家先回去休息___，剩下的明天再做。
items.zh: 时间不早了，大家先回去休息吧，剩下的明天再做。
items.py: shí jiān bù zǎo le dà jiā xiān huí qù xiū xi ba shèng xià de míng tiān zài zuò
items.en: It's getting late; let's all go home and rest first, and do the rest tomorrow.
items.why: The speaker proposes ending the work for today: 吧. 吗 would ask and 呢 or 的 would only describe.

items.q: 老师说下周要交报告，可是资料还没找齐，我们该怎么办___？
items.zh: 老师说下周要交报告，可是资料还没找齐，我们该怎么办呢？
items.py: lǎo shī shuō xià zhōu yào jiāo bào gào kě shì zī liào hái méi zhǎo qí wǒ men gāi zěn me bàn ne
items.en: The teacher says the report is due next week, but we haven't even gathered the materials. So what should we do?
items.why: 怎么办 is a question word, so 吗 is out; 呢 gives the worried 'so what now?' tone. 吧 would make a suggestion, which a question-word question does not take.

items.q: 我本来想去，现在不想去___。
items.zh: 我本来想去，现在不想去了。
items.py: wǒ běn lái xiǎng qù xiàn zài bù xiǎng qù le
items.en: I did want to go, but I don't want to any more.
items.why: 本来 ... 现在不 ... 了 marks a change in wishes: 'not any more'. 吗 would ask and 吧 would turn it into a guess.

items.q: 你这个周末加不加班___？
items.zh: 你这个周末加不加班？
items.py: nǐ zhè ge zhōu mò jiā bù jiā bān
items.en: Are you working overtime this weekend or not?
items.why: 加不加班 is a verb-不-verb question already, so adding 吗 doubles the question. Use 吗 or A-not-A, never both.

items.q: 别担心，你会好___。
items.zh: 别担心，你会好的。
items.py: bié dān xīn nǐ huì hǎo de
items.en: Don't worry, you'll get better.
items.why: 会 + verb or adjective + 的 is a calm assurance about the future. 了 reports a change that has already happened.

items.zh: 我保证，我不会迟到的。
items.py: wǒ bǎo zhèng wǒ bù huì chí dào de
items.en: I promise I won't be late.
items.why: 不会...的 is the standard promise form. The final 的 is not the 是...的 pattern; it adds certainty.

items.q: 快来___，电影马上就要开始了！
items.zh: 快来啊，电影马上就要开始了！
items.py: kuài lái a diàn yǐng mǎ shàng jiù yào kāi shǐ le
items.en: Come on, hurry; the film is about to start!
items.why: 啊 gives friendly urgency to 快来. 吗 would ask whether the person is coming, and 呢 or 的 do not urge.

items.q: 天黑___，我们回家吧。
items.zh: 天黑了，我们回家吧。
items.py: tiān hēi le wǒ men huí jiā ba
items.en: It's gotten dark; let's go home.
items.why: 天黑了 reports a new situation: it was light, now it is dark. 呢 would mean it is still dark, and 吗 would ask.

items.q: 他一定会来___，你再等一会儿。
items.zh: 他一定会来的，你再等一会儿。
items.py: tā yī dìng huì lái de nǐ zài děng yī huì r
items.en: He will definitely come; wait a little longer.
items.why: 一定会...的 is a firm reassurance about the future. 了 would say he has already arrived or changed, and 吗 would ask a question instead of reassuring.

items.q: 别担心，报告我还没写完___，不过明天才交，来得及。
items.zh: 别担心，报告我还没写完呢，不过明天才交，来得及。
items.py: bié dān xīn bào gào wǒ hái méi xiě wán ne bù guò míng tiān cái jiāo lái de jí
items.en: Don't worry, I haven't finished the report yet, but it isn't due until tomorrow, so there's time.
items.why: 还没 + verb + 呢: nothing has changed yet. 了 cannot follow 还没, and 吗 would turn the reassurance into a question.

items.zh: 我喝茶，你呢？
items.py: wǒ hē chá nǐ ne
items.en: I'm having tea. What about you?
items.why: The first clause states the speaker's choice, then pronoun + 呢 bounces the question back to the listener.

items.q: 你刚来公司不久，大概对这里的工作还不太熟悉___？
items.zh: 你刚来公司不久，大概对这里的工作还不太熟悉吧？
items.py: nǐ gāng lái gōng sī bù jiǔ dà gài duì zhè lǐ de gōng zuò hái bù tài shú xī ba
items.en: You've only just joined the company, so I suppose you're not very familiar with the work here yet?
items.why: 大概 marks the speaker's guess and 吧 asks for confirmation. 吗 asks with no opinion, and 呢 cannot form a yes/no question.

items.q: 这次考试应该不难___？
items.zh: 这次考试应该不难吧？
items.py: zhè cì kǎo shì yīng gāi bù nán ba
items.en: The exam shouldn't have been hard, I suppose?
items.why: 应该 shows the speaker expects a yes, so 吧. 吗 asks with no expectation and does not combine with 应该.

items.q: 自从孩子上了小学，她就不再像以前那么忙___。
items.zh: 自从孩子上了小学，她就不再像以前那么忙了。
items.py: zì cóng hái zi shàng le xiǎo xué tā jiù bù zài xiàng yǐ qián nà me máng le
items.en: Since her child started primary school, she has no longer been as busy as before.
items.why: 不再...了 marks a change from before. 吗 would ask and 呢 would say she is still that busy, which contradicts 不再.

items.s_py: nǐ míng tiān lái bù lái shàng kè ma
items.zh: 你明天来不来上课？
items.py: nǐ míng tiān lái bù lái shàng kè
items.en: Are you coming to class tomorrow or not?
items.why: 来不来 is already the question. Use verb-不-verb or 吗, never both.

items.s_py: nǐ shì xīn lái de lǎo shī ba ma
items.zh: 你是新来的老师吧？
items.py: nǐ shì xīn lái de lǎo shī ba
items.en: You're the new teacher, right?
items.why: 吧 and 吗 are two different sentence-final particles and never combine. 吧 alone asks for confirmation of a guess.

items.q: 你的新衣服多漂亮___！
items.zh: 你的新衣服多漂亮啊！
items.py: nǐ de xīn yī fu duō piào liang a
items.en: How pretty your new clothes are!
items.why: 多 + adjective + 啊 is an exclamation. 吗 would ask, and 吧 and 了 do not express admiration.

items.q: 不想去就不去___，没人会勉强你。
items.zh: 不想去就不去呗，没人会勉强你。
items.py: bù xiǎng qù jiù bù qù bei méi rén huì miǎn qiǎng nǐ
items.en: If you don't want to go, then don't; nobody will force you.
items.why: 不想去就不去呗: simple, no big deal. 吗 would ask, and 呢 and 的 do not give the shrugging 'so be it'.

items.q: 你们大概都饿了___，我们去吃饭。
items.zh: 你们大概都饿了吧，我们去吃饭。
items.py: nǐ men dà gài dōu è le ba wǒ men qù chī fàn
items.en: You're probably all hungry; let's go and eat.
items.why: 大概 marks a guess, which 吧 carries. 吗 is a neutral question and does not combine with 大概.

items.q: 明天的会议经理一定会参加___？
items.zh: 明天的会议经理一定会参加吧？
items.py: míng tiān de huì yì jīng lǐ yī dìng huì cān jiā ba
items.en: The manager will surely attend tomorrow's meeting, won't he?
items.why: 一定会 shows a firm belief, and 吧 asks the listener to confirm it. 吗 asks with no opinion and does not fit 一定.

items.s_py: wǒ hái méi xiě wán zuò yè le
items.zh: 我还没写完作业呢。
items.py: wǒ hái méi xiě wán zuò yè ne
items.en: I haven't finished my homework yet.
items.why: 还没 means nothing has happened yet, so 了 cannot end the sentence. 呢 marks 'still the case'.

items.q: 现在才九点___，会议十点才开始。
items.zh: 现在才九点呢，会议十点才开始。
items.py: xiàn zài cái jiǔ diǎn ne huì yì shí diǎn cái kāi shǐ
items.en: It's only nine o'clock now; the meeting doesn't start until ten.
items.why: 才 + time + 呢 says 'only'. 了 would claim it has become nine as news, which clashes with 才, and 吗 would ask.

items.src_py: wǒ men míng tiān qù pá shān
items.task: Turn it into a suggestion: 'Let's...'.
items.zh: 我们明天去爬山吧。
items.py: wǒ men míng tiān qù pá shān ba
items.en: Let's go hiking tomorrow.
items.why: 吧 at the end turns the plan into a suggestion; 吗 would ask a question instead.

items.q: 你昨晚肯定没睡好___？
items.zh: 你昨晚肯定没睡好吧？
items.py: nǐ zuó wǎn kěn dìng méi shuì hǎo ba
items.en: You must not have slept well last night, right?
items.why: 肯定 shows the speaker is sure and wants confirmation: 吧. 吗 would ask neutrally and clashes with 肯定.

items.q: 我还没做作业___。
items.zh: 我还没做作业呢。
items.py: wǒ hái méi zuò zuò yè ne
items.en: I haven't done my homework yet.
items.why: 还没 says nothing has happened yet, so 了 is impossible. 呢 marks 'still the case'; 吗 would ask a question.

items.q: 你们公司下个月要搬到新办公室___？
items.zh: 你们公司下个月要搬到新办公室吗？
items.py: nǐ men gōng sī xià ge yuè yào bān dào xīn bàn gōng shì ma
items.en: Is your company moving to a new office next month?
items.why: A plain statement the speaker is unsure of becomes a neutral yes/no question with 吗. 嘛 sounds the same but means 'obviously' and asks nothing; 呢 and 的 do not ask yes/no questions.

items.zh: 你明天有时间吗？
items.py: nǐ míng tiān yǒu shí jiān ma
items.en: Do you have time tomorrow?
items.why: 吗 goes at the very end of a statement to ask a yes/no question; the time word may sit before or after the subject.

items.src_py: nǐ xǐ huan zhè ge gōng zuò
items.task: Turn it into a yes/no question.
items.zh: 你喜欢这个工作吗？
items.py: nǐ xǐ huan zhè ge gōng zuò ma
items.en: Do you like this job?
items.why: Adding 吗 at the end turns a statement into a yes/no question; nothing else moves.

items.src_py: wǒ xiǎng qù běi jīng gōng zuò
items.task: Say you don't want to any more.
items.zh: 我不想去北京工作了。
items.py: wǒ bù xiǎng qù běi jīng gōng zuò le
items.en: I don't want to go and work in Beijing any more.
items.why: 'Not any more' is 不 + verb + 了; without the final 了 it would only say 'I don't want to'.

items.zh: 他还没回来呢。
items.py: tā hái méi huí lái ne
items.en: He hasn't come back yet.
items.why: 还没...呢 is the standard way to say 'not yet'; 了 is never used after 还没.

items.q: 你说得对，好___，我听你的。
items.zh: 你说得对，好吧，我听你的。
items.py: nǐ shuō de duì hǎo ba wǒ tīng nǐ de
items.en: You're right. All right then, I'll do as you say.
items.why: 好吧 is giving in: 'all right then'. 好吗 asks 'okay?' and does not fit a speaker who is agreeing.

items.q: 小王___？他今天没来上课吗？
items.zh: 小王呢？他今天没来上课吗？
items.py: xiǎo wáng ne tā jīn tiān méi lái shàng kè ma
items.en: Where's Xiao Wang? Didn't he come to class today?
items.why: A bare name + 呢 asks 'where is...?' when nothing was said before. 吗 needs a full statement, and 了 or 的 do not ask.

items.s: 你不是说今天不上班吗？
items.zh: 你不是说今天不上班吗？
items.py: nǐ bù shì shuō jīn tiān bù shàng bān ma
items.en: Didn't you say you weren't working today?
items.why: 吗 can follow a negative statement to ask for confirmation. The sentence has no question word, A-not-A or 还是, so 吗 is correct.

items.zh: 他已经不是小孩子了。
items.py: tā yǐ jīng bù shì xiǎo hái zi le
items.en: He's no longer a little kid.
items.why: 已经不是...了 says 'no longer'. Dropping 了 would leave the change of state unmarked.

items.q: 你要是觉得办公室太吵，就戴上耳机___，没什么大不了的。
items.zh: 你要是觉得办公室太吵，就戴上耳机呗，没什么大不了的。
items.py: nǐ yào shi jué de bàn gōng shì tài chǎo jiù dài shàng ěr jī bei méi shén me dà bù liǎo de
items.en: If you find the office too noisy, just put on headphones; it's no big deal.
items.why: 要是...就...呗 offers the simple fix, and 没什么大不了 matches the casual tone. 吗 would ask a question, and 呢 is not a solution.

items.s_py: nǐ de xué xiào zài nǎ r ma
items.zh: 你的学校在哪儿？
items.py: nǐ de xué xiào zài nǎ r
items.en: Where is your school?
items.why: 哪儿 already makes this a question, so 吗 cannot be added. 吗 is only for turning a statement into a yes/no question.

items.s: 放心，他明天一定会准时到了。
items.s_py: fàng xīn tā míng tiān yī dìng huì zhǔn shí dào le
items.zh: 放心，他明天一定会准时到的。
items.py: fàng xīn tā míng tiān yī dìng huì zhǔn shí dào de
items.en: Rest assured, he'll definitely arrive on time tomorrow.
items.why: Assurance about the future is 一定会...的. 了 announces a change and cannot follow 一定会 about tomorrow.

items.q: 快复习___，下午还要考试。
items.zh: 快复习吧，下午还要考试。
items.py: kuài fù xí ba xià wǔ hái yào kǎo shì
items.en: Hurry up and revise; there's an exam this afternoon.
items.why: 吧 softens the urging 快复习 so it is advice, not an order. 吗 would ask a question and 呢 would describe an ongoing state.

items.q: 我学中文，你___？
items.zh: 我学中文，你呢？
items.py: wǒ xué zhōng wén nǐ ne
items.en: I'm learning Chinese. What about you?
items.why: 'And you?' bounces the topic back with a bare pronoun + 呢. 吗 needs a complete statement before it.

items.q: 我早就跟你说过这个方法不行___，你怎么还不信？
items.zh: 我早就跟你说过这个方法不行嘛，你怎么还不信？
items.py: wǒ zǎo jiù gēn nǐ shuō guo zhè ge fāng fǎ bù xíng ma nǐ zěn me hái bù xìn
items.en: I told you long ago this method wouldn't work, so why won't you believe me?
items.why: The speaker is pointing out something that should be obvious: 嘛. 吗 would ask whether it works, and the next clause shows the speaker is complaining.

items.q: 这是我的书___，你拿错了！
items.zh: 这是我的书嘛，你拿错了！
items.py: zhè shì wǒ de shū ma nǐ ná cuò le
items.en: This is my book, obviously; you took the wrong one!
items.why: 嘛 states the obvious: 'it's my book, can't you see?'. 吗 would ask whether it is my book, which does not fit the complaint.

items.q: 我们怎么回家___？
items.zh: 我们怎么回家呢？
items.py: wǒ men zěn me huí jiā ne
items.en: So how shall we get home?
items.why: 怎么 already makes this a question, so 吗 is impossible; 呢 only softens it into 'so how...?'.

items.q: 你想坐地铁还是想打车___？
items.zh: 你想坐地铁还是想打车？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng zuò dì tiě hái shi xiǎng dǎ chē
items.en: Do you want to take the subway or a taxi?
items.why: 还是 asks the listener to choose, so the sentence is already a question and 吗 cannot be added.

items.q: 这个问题很难，我们明天再讨论___。
items.zh: 这个问题很难，我们明天再讨论吧。
items.py: zhè ge wèn tí hěn nán wǒ men míng tiān zài tǎo lùn ba
items.en: This question is hard; let's discuss it tomorrow.
items.why: 再 + verb + 吧 proposes doing it later. 吗 would ask a question, and 了 cannot follow a future 明天再.

items.q: 我弟弟高中毕业了，现在是大学生___。
items.zh: 我弟弟高中毕业了，现在是大学生了。
items.py: wǒ dì di gāo zhōng bì yè le xiàn zài shì dà xué shēng le
items.en: My younger brother has finished high school; now he's a university student.
items.why: 现在是...了 marks a new status after graduating. 吗 would ask, and 吧 would guess at a fact the speaker already knows.

items.q: 这个字你认识___？
items.zh: 这个字你认识吗？
items.py: zhè ge zì nǐ rèn shi ma
items.en: Do you know this character?
items.why: A statement with no question word turns into a yes/no question with 吗. 呢 only follows a bare noun or an existing question.

items.zh: 我们明天几点见面呢？
items.py: wǒ men míng tiān jǐ diǎn jiàn miàn ne
items.en: So what time shall we meet tomorrow?
items.why: 呢 can follow a question-word question to make it sound thoughtful. It is correct here because 吗 is not allowed after 几点.

items.q: 你们的教室真大___！我们学校的小多了。
items.zh: 你们的教室真大啊！我们学校的小多了。
items.py: nǐ men de jiào shì zhēn dà a wǒ men xué xiào de xiǎo duō le
items.en: Your classroom is so big! The ones at our school are much smaller.
items.why: 真 + adjective is an exclamation, so 啊 adds the feeling. 吗 would ask whether it is big and the following comparison shows the speaker already knows.

items.q: 你到底去不去___？
items.zh: 你到底去不去呢？
items.py: nǐ dào dǐ qù bù qù ne
items.en: So are you going or not?
items.why: 去不去 is already the question, so 吗 cannot be added. 呢 adds a thoughtful or impatient tone to an A-not-A question.

items.q: 天气越来越冷___，你该多穿一件衣服。
items.zh: 天气越来越冷了，你该多穿一件衣服。
items.py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè lěng le nǐ gāi duō chuān yī jiàn yī fu
items.en: It's getting colder; you should put on another layer.
items.why: 越来越 + adjective ends with 了 because things are changing. 呢 would say it is cold now and nothing more, and 吗 would ask.

items.q: 我的书包___？我找不到了。
items.zh: 我的书包呢？我找不到了。
items.py: wǒ de shū bāo ne wǒ zhǎo bù dào le
items.en: Where's my school bag? I can't find it.
items.why: Noun + 呢 asks where something is. 吗 needs a full statement, and 吧 or 了 do not ask for a location.

items.q: 你怎么天天不高兴？你不喜欢这份工作___？
items.zh: 你怎么天天不高兴？你不喜欢这份工作吗？
items.py: nǐ zěn me tiān tiān bù gāo xìng nǐ bù xǐ huan zhè fèn gōng zuò ma
items.en: Why are you unhappy every day? Don't you like this job?
items.why: 吗 can follow a negative statement to ask whether it is true. 嘛 would say 'obviously you don't like it', and 呢 cannot make a statement into a question.

items.s: 不想吃就别吃呗，没人逼你。
items.zh: 不想吃就别吃呗，没人逼你。
items.py: bù xiǎng chī jiù bié chī bei méi rén bī nǐ
items.en: If you don't want to eat it, then don't; nobody's forcing you.
items.why: 呗 closes a 就 sentence with a shrug: 'then just don't'. It is casual but correct.

items.q: 这么简单的题，你当然会做___。
items.zh: 这么简单的题，你当然会做嘛。
items.py: zhè me jiǎn dān de tí nǐ dāng rán huì zuò ma
items.en: Such an easy problem, of course you can do it, come on.
items.why: 当然 signals the obvious, so 嘛. 吗 would ask whether you can, and 吧 would make it a tentative guess.

items.q: 你看，外面下着大雪___，今天别出去了。
items.zh: 你看，外面下着大雪呢，今天别出去了。
items.py: nǐ kàn wài miàn xià zhe dà xuě ne jīn tiān bié chū qù le
items.en: Look, it's snowing heavily outside; don't go out today.
items.why: 着 shows the snow is still falling and 呢 stresses that state. 了 would say it has just started, and 吗 would ask a question the speaker is not asking.

items.q: 这么晚了，他今天大概不会来参加聚会___。
items.zh: 这么晚了，他今天大概不会来参加聚会吧。
items.py: zhè me wǎn le tā jīn tiān dà gài bù huì lái cān jiā jù huì ba
items.en: It's so late; he probably won't come to the party today.
items.why: 大概 + 吧 is a probable guess. 吗 would ask a question, and 啊 would add feeling without making it tentative.

items.q: 你家有洗衣机___？
items.zh: 你家有洗衣机吗？
items.py: nǐ jiā yǒu xǐ yī jī ma
items.en: Do you have a washing machine at home?
items.why: A plain statement becomes a neutral yes/no question with 吗. 呢 needs a bare noun or a sentence that already is a question, and 的 and 呗 do not ask anything.

items.q: 你想喝什么___？
items.zh: 你想喝什么？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng hē shén me
items.en: What do you want to drink?
items.why: 什么 already makes this a question, so nothing more is added. 吗 is only for turning a statement into a yes/no question, never after a question word.

items.q: 你爸爸喜欢这个杯子___？
items.zh: 你爸爸喜欢这个杯子吗？
items.py: nǐ bà ba xǐ huan zhè gè bēi zi ma
items.en: Does your dad like this cup?
items.why: The speaker has no idea and asks a neutral yes/no question, so the sentence takes 吗. 呢 cannot turn a statement into a yes/no question, and 的 or 呗 make no question at all.

items.q: 你要现金还是刷卡___？
items.zh: 你要现金还是刷卡？
items.py: nǐ yào xiàn jīn hái shì shuā kǎ
items.en: Will you pay cash or by card?
items.why: 还是 already asks the listener to choose, so the sentence is complete. Adding 吗 would pile a second question marker on top of 还是, which no native does.

items.q: 你们明天去不去超市___？
items.zh: 你们明天去不去超市？
items.py: nǐ men míng tiān qù bù qù chāo shì
items.en: Are you going to the supermarket tomorrow or not?
items.why: 去不去 is the question, an A-not-A form. 吗 would double it, so the sentence ends right after 超市.

items.q: 我不知道是谁的，这个钱包是你的___？
items.zh: 我不知道是谁的，这个钱包是你的吗？
items.py: wǒ bù zhī dào shì shuí de zhè gè qián bāo shì nǐ de ma
items.en: I don't know whose it is. Is this wallet yours?
items.why: The speaker has no guess and asks a neutral yes/no question: 吗. 嘛 says the answer is obvious and never asks, and 呢 cannot make a statement a question.

items.q: 你是想知道哪家超市的东西最便宜___？
items.zh: 你是想知道哪家超市的东西最便宜吗？
items.py: nǐ shì xiǎng zhī dào nǎ jiā chāo shì de dōng xi zuì biàn yi ma
items.en: Do you want to know which supermarket has the cheapest things?
items.why: 哪家 sits inside a clause after 想知道; the whole sentence asks yes or no (do you want to know...), so it takes 吗. The wh-word does not make the main sentence a wh-question.

items.q: 你们家每个月的水电费都是妈妈一个人付___？
items.zh: 你们家每个月的水电费都是妈妈一个人付吗？
items.py: nǐ men jiā měi gè yuè de shuǐ diàn fèi dōu shì mā ma yī gè rén fù ma
items.en: Is it always Mom alone who pays the utility bills every month?
items.why: The sentence is a statement with no question word or A-not-A, so a yes/no question needs 吗. 嘛 would claim it is obvious, and 呢 or 呗 do not ask a yes/no question.

items.q: 我吃面条，你___？
items.zh: 我吃面条，你呢？
items.py: wǒ chī miàn tiáo nǐ ne
items.en: I'm having noodles. What about you?
items.why: Pronoun + 呢 bounces the same question back: "and you?". 吗 needs a full statement before it, so 你吗 does not work here.

items.q: 我的钥匙___？
items.zh: 我的钥匙呢？
items.py: wǒ de yào shi ne
items.en: Where are my keys?
items.why: A bare noun + 呢 asks where something is. 吗 would need a full statement, and 了 or 的 cannot follow a bare noun.

items.q: 妈妈去超市了，爸爸___？
items.zh: 妈妈去超市了，爸爸呢？
items.py: mā ma qù chāo shì le bà ba ne
items.en: Mom went to the supermarket. What about Dad?
items.why: The pattern "A did this; and what about B?" is noun + 呢. 吗 does not attach to a bare noun.

items.q: 这个太贵了，那个___？
items.zh: 这个太贵了，那个呢？
items.py: zhè gè tài guì le nà gè ne
items.en: This one is too expensive. What about that one?
items.why: Comparing a second item to the first one is noun + 呢 ("what about that one?"). 吗 needs a full statement, and 嘛 states the obvious and never asks.

items.q: 你到底想不想买这台电视___？
items.zh: 你到底想不想买这台电视呢？
items.py: nǐ dào dǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng mǎi zhè tái diàn shì ne
items.en: So do you want to buy this TV or not?
items.why: 想不想 is already the question, so 吗 is impossible after it. 呢 only makes it sound a little impatient or thoughtful.

items.q: 我们怎么把这个大沙发搬回家___？
items.zh: 我们怎么把这个大沙发搬回家呢？
items.py: wǒ men zěn me bǎ zhè gè dà shā fā bān huí jiā ne
items.en: So how are we going to get this big sofa home?
items.why: 怎么 makes this a question-word question, so 吗 cannot be added. 呢 is the particle that can soften such a question.

items.q: 你昨天说奶奶要来，她什么时候到___？
items.zh: 你昨天说奶奶要来，她什么时候到呢？
items.py: nǐ zuó tiān shuō nǎi nai yào lái tā shén me shí hòu dào ne
items.en: You said yesterday that Grandma is coming. When does she arrive?
items.why: 什么时候 asks for information, so 吗 is impossible; 呢 can soften the question.

items.q: 家里的钱已经不够了，下个月的房租怎么办___？
items.zh: 家里的钱已经不够了，下个月的房租怎么办呢？
items.py: jiā lǐ de qián yǐ jīng bù gòu le xià gè yuè de fáng zū zěn me bàn ne
items.en: The money at home is already not enough. What are we going to do about next month's rent?
items.why: 怎么办 is a question-word question, so 吗 fails. 呢 adds a worried, thinking-aloud tone to the question.

items.q: 别吵，弟弟在写作业___。
items.zh: 别吵，弟弟在写作业呢。
items.py: bié chǎo dì di zài xiě zuò yè ne
items.en: Don't make noise; my younger brother is doing homework.
items.why: 在 + verb + 呢 says the action is going on right now. 吗 would make it a question, and 吧 and 的 do not mark an ongoing action.

items.q: 爸爸还没回家___。
items.zh: 爸爸还没回家呢。
items.py: bà ba hái méi huí jiā ne
items.en: Dad hasn't come home yet.
items.why: 还没 means nothing has changed yet, so 了 is impossible. 呢 marks "still the case".

items.q: 现在才六点___，再睡一会儿。
items.zh: 现在才六点呢，再睡一会儿。
items.py: xiàn zài cái liù diǎn ne zài shuì yī huì r
items.en: It's only six o'clock now; sleep a little longer.
items.why: 才 + time + 呢 stresses "only", against the listener's assumption that it is late. 了 would announce a change, but the situation has not changed.

items.q: 妈妈正在做饭___，你先别进去。
items.zh: 妈妈正在做饭呢，你先别进去。
items.py: mā ma zhèng zài zuò fàn ne nǐ xiān bié jìn qù
items.en: Mom is cooking right now; don't go in yet.
items.why: 正在 + verb + 呢 describes what is happening at this moment. 了 would say the cooking is finished or has started, and 吗 would make a question.

items.q: 这件外套我还没付钱___，不能带走。
items.zh: 这件外套我还没付钱呢，不能带走。
items.py: zhè jiàn wài tào wǒ hái méi fù qián ne bù néng dài zǒu
items.en: I haven't paid for this coat yet, so I can't take it.
items.why: 还没付钱 describes a situation that has not changed, so 呢. 了 contradicts 还没, and 吧 would turn it into a guess.

items.q: 门口站着好几个人___，你去看看是谁。
items.zh: 门口站着好几个人呢，你去看看是谁。
items.py: mén kǒu zhàn zhe hǎo jǐ gè rén ne nǐ qù kàn kàn shì shuí
items.en: Several people are standing at the door; go and see who it is.
items.why: Verb + 着 + 呢 reports a state that is going on right now. 吗 would ask a question, and 的 and 呗 do not describe a current state.

items.q: 你以为我会买吗？我才不买___！
items.zh: 你以为我会买吗？我才不买呢！
items.py: nǐ yǐ wèi wǒ huì mǎi ma wǒ cái bù mǎi ne
items.en: You think I'd buy it? I certainly won't buy it!
items.why: 才不 + verb + 呢 is a strong denial: "certainly not". 吗 would turn the denial into a question, and 吧 would soften it into a guess.

items.q: 别急着收拾，爷爷奶奶还没到___，客人都要六点以后才来。
items.zh: 别急着收拾，爷爷奶奶还没到呢，客人都要六点以后才来。
items.py: bié jí zhe shōu shí yé ye nǎi nai hái méi dào ne kè rén dōu yào liù diǎn yǐ hòu cái lái
items.en: Don't rush to tidy up. Grandpa and Grandma haven't arrived yet, and the guests won't come until after six.
items.why: 还没到 says the arrival has not happened, so the sentence takes 呢 for "still the case". 了 clashes with 还没, and 吗 would ask instead of reassure.

items.q: 这个月的工资还没发___，我哪有钱买新手机？
items.zh: 这个月的工资还没发呢，我哪有钱买新手机？
items.py: zhè gè yuè de gōng zī hái méi fā ne wǒ nǎ yǒu qián mǎi xīn shǒu jī
items.en: This month's pay hasn't come in yet; where would I get money for a new phone?
items.why: 还没发 is a situation that has not changed, which is 呢, never 了. 吗 would ask whether it has come in, but the speaker is giving a reason.

items.q: 我们回家___。
items.zh: 我们回家吧。
items.py: wǒ men huí jiā ba
items.en: Let's go home.
items.why: "Let's..." is a suggestion, which is 吧. 吗 would ask "are we going home?", and 呢 or 的 make no proposal.

items.q: 天太热了，你们喝点水___。
items.zh: 天太热了，你们喝点水吧。
items.py: tiān tài rè le nǐ men hē diǎn shuǐ ba
items.en: It's too hot; why don't you drink some water.
items.why: A gentle recommendation takes 吧. 吗 would ask whether they drink water, and 呢 or 了 do not make a suggestion.

items.q: 这个杯子很便宜，你买___。
items.zh: 这个杯子很便宜，你买吧。
items.py: zhè gè bēi zi hěn biàn yi nǐ mǎi ba
items.en: This cup is cheap; why don't you buy it?
items.why: The speaker recommends an action, which is 吧. 吗 would ask a fact question about whether you buy it.

items.q: 太晚了，我们明天再去超市___。
items.zh: 太晚了，我们明天再去超市吧。
items.py: tài wǎn le wǒ men míng tiān zài qù chāo shì ba
items.en: It's too late; let's go to the supermarket tomorrow.
items.why: Proposing a new plan ("let's...") takes 吧. 吗 would ask a question instead of proposing, and 的 or 呢 do not make a proposal.

items.q: 好___，这个价钱我就买了。
items.zh: 好吧，这个价钱我就买了。
items.py: hǎo ba zhè gè jià qián wǒ jiù mǎi le
items.en: All right then, at this price I'll buy it.
items.why: 好吧 means giving in: "all right then". 好吗 would ask "OK?", and 好呢 or 好着 are not set phrases.

items.q: 你先把菜洗好，我来切___。
items.zh: 你先把菜洗好，我来切吧。
items.py: nǐ xiān bǎ cài xǐ hǎo wǒ lái qiè ba
items.en: You wash the vegetables first, and I'll chop them.
items.why: Splitting up the work is a proposal, so 吧 softens it. 吗 would ask whether I will chop, and 呢 would say I am chopping right now.

items.q: 要是价钱谈不下来，你就别买了，我们去别的店看看___。
items.zh: 要是价钱谈不下来，你就别买了，我们去别的店看看吧。
items.py: yào shì jià qián tán bù xià lái nǐ jiù bié mǎi le wǒ men qù bié de diàn kàn kàn ba
items.en: If you can't get the price down, don't buy it; let's look in other shops.
items.why: Proposing to look elsewhere is a suggestion: 吧. 吗 would ask a question, and 了 would claim they are already going.

items.q: 你妈妈累了一天了，今晚的碗就让我们来洗___。
items.zh: 你妈妈累了一天了，今晚的碗就让我们来洗吧。
items.py: nǐ mā ma lèi le yī tiān le jīn wǎn de wǎn jiù ràng wǒ men lái xǐ ba
items.en: Your mom has been tired all day; let's wash tonight's dishes ourselves.
items.why: "Let us do it" is a proposal, so 吧. 吗 would ask whether we wash them, and 呢 would describe it as going on now.

items.q: 我看你们很像，你是小王的妈妈___？
items.zh: 我看你们很像，你是小王的妈妈吧？
items.py: wǒ kàn nǐ men hěn xiàng nǐ shì xiǎo wáng de mā ma ba
items.en: You look alike, so you're Xiao Wang's mom, right?
items.why: The speaker has a guess (你们很像) and wants confirmation: 吧. 吗 would be a question with no opinion at all.

items.q: 你常常去那家超市，你家离那儿很近___？
items.zh: 你常常去那家超市，你家离那儿很近吧？
items.py: nǐ cháng cháng qù nà jiā chāo shì nǐ jiā lí nà r hěn jìn ba
items.en: You often go to that supermarket, so your home is close to it, I suppose?
items.why: Because you often go there is a clue, the speaker already believes it and wants a "right?": 吧. 吗 would mean the speaker has no idea.

items.q: 这条裙子看起来很好，不便宜___？
items.zh: 这条裙子看起来很好，不便宜吧？
items.py: zhè tiáo qún zi kàn qǐ lái hěn hǎo bù biàn yi ba
items.en: This skirt looks nice; it isn't cheap, I suppose?
items.why: A guess based on appearance, hoping for agreement, takes 吧. 吗 would ask with no opinion, and 的 makes no question.

items.q: 你们家今年大概不回老家过年了___？
items.zh: 你们家今年大概不回老家过年了吧？
items.py: nǐ men jiā jīn nián dà gài bù huí lǎo jiā guò nián le ba
items.en: You probably won't go back to your hometown for New Year this year, I suppose?
items.why: 大概 marks a guess, so the sentence takes 吧. 吗 would ask with no opinion and sounds odd with 大概.

items.q: 爸爸应该已经买好票了___？
items.zh: 爸爸应该已经买好票了吧？
items.py: bà ba yīng gāi yǐ jīng mǎi hǎo piào le ba
items.en: Dad should have bought the tickets already, I take it?
items.why: 应该 shows the speaker's guess and 吧 asks for confirmation. 吗 clashes with 应该, and 嘛 says it is obvious without asking.

items.q: 你一个月的工资一定不少___？
items.zh: 你一个月的工资一定不少吧？
items.py: nǐ yī gè yuè de gōng zī yī dìng bù shǎo ba
items.en: You surely earn a good salary a month, I suppose?
items.why: 一定 shows the speaker assumes it is so, and 吧 asks for confirmation. 吗 would be asked with no assumption.

items.q: 看你买了这么多东西，今天的特价活动你一定早就知道了___？
items.zh: 看你买了这么多东西，今天的特价活动你一定早就知道了吧？
items.py: kàn nǐ mǎi le zhè me duō dōng xi jīn tiān de tè jià huó dòng nǐ yī dìng zǎo jiù zhī dào le ba
items.en: Seeing how much you bought, you must have known about today's sale long ago, I take it?
items.why: The speaker infers from the evidence and asks for agreement, which is 吧. 吗 asks with no opinion, and 呢 or 的 do not ask.

items.q: 你刚搬来这个小区，邻居们还不太熟___？
items.zh: 你刚搬来这个小区，邻居们还不太熟吧？
items.py: nǐ gāng bān lái zhè gè xiǎo qū lín jū men hái bù tài shú ba
items.en: You just moved into this neighborhood, so you probably don't know the neighbors well yet?
items.why: The speaker infers from the fact that you just moved in and invites confirmation: 吧. 吗 would show no expectation at all.

items.q: 这个蛋糕真好吃___！
items.zh: 这个蛋糕真好吃啊！
items.py: zhè gè dàn gāo zhēn hǎo chī a
items.en: This cake is so delicious!
items.why: 真 + adjective + 啊 is a warm exclamation. 吗 would turn the exclamation into a yes/no question, and 的 and 了 do not fit.

items.q: 妈妈做的饭多香___！
items.zh: 妈妈做的饭多香啊！
items.py: mā ma zuò de fàn duō xiāng a
items.en: How tasty Mom's cooking is!
items.why: 多 + adjective + 啊 is an exclamation. 吗 would ask a question, and 吧 would make it a guess.

items.q: 快来___，饭做好了！
items.zh: 快来啊，饭做好了！
items.py: kuài lái a fàn zuò hǎo le
items.en: Come on, hurry, the meal is ready!
items.why: 啊 makes friendly urging: "come on!". 吗 would ask "are you coming?", and 的 and 呢 do not urge.

items.q: 这家店的衣服真便宜！是___，我们多买几件。
items.zh: 这家店的衣服真便宜！是啊，我们多买几件。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn de yī fu zhēn biàn yi shì a wǒ men duō mǎi jǐ jiàn
items.en: The clothes in this shop are so cheap! Yes, they are; let's buy a few more.
items.why: 是啊 is warm agreement: "yes, exactly". 是吗 would ask "really?", which does not fit the speaker agreeing.

items.q: 奶奶，您慢点走___，小心台阶！
items.zh: 奶奶，您慢点走啊，小心台阶！
items.py: nǎi nai nín màn diǎn zǒu a xiǎo xīn tái jiē
items.en: Grandma, walk slowly, mind the steps!
items.why: 啊 gives a caring, urging tone to the warning. 吗 would ask a question, and 呗 would sound careless, the opposite of caring.

items.q: 这个孩子长得多可爱___！
items.zh: 这个孩子长得多可爱啊！
items.py: zhè gè hái zi zhǎng de duō kě ài a
items.en: How cute this child is!
items.why: 多可爱 + 啊 is an exclamation. 吗 would ask a question, and 吧 would turn it into a guess. 嘛 would say it is obvious.

items.q: 你们看，这个小区的环境多好___，楼下还有一个大超市！
items.zh: 你们看，这个小区的环境多好啊，楼下还有一个大超市！
items.py: nǐ men kàn zhè gè xiǎo qū de huán jìng duō hǎo a lóu xià hái yǒu yī gè dà chāo shì
items.en: Look how nice this neighborhood is, and there's a big supermarket downstairs!
items.why: 多好 + 啊 is an exclamation of delight. 吗 would turn it into a yes/no question, and 吧 would make a guess out of what the speaker can see.

items.q: 能和家人一起过年，真是太幸福___！
items.zh: 能和家人一起过年，真是太幸福啊！
items.py: néng hé jiā rén yī qǐ guò nián zhēn shì tài xìng fú a
items.en: Being able to spend New Year with the family is such happiness!
items.why: 真是太 + adjective + 啊 is a warm exclamation. 吗 would ask a question, which is the opposite of an exclamation.

items.q: 你是我哥哥___，当然要帮我。
items.zh: 你是我哥哥嘛，当然要帮我。
items.py: nǐ shì wǒ gē ge ma dāng rán yào bāng wǒ
items.en: You're my older brother, after all; of course you should help me.
items.why: 嘛 says "obviously, after all" and never asks. 吗 would turn it into a question and spoil 当然 in the next clause.

items.q: 太贵了，不买就不买___。
items.zh: 太贵了，不买就不买呗。
items.py: tài guì le bù mǎi jiù bù mǎi bei
items.en: It's too expensive. If we don't buy it, we don't buy it.
items.why: 不...就不...呗 means "so be it, no big deal". 吗 would ask a question, and 呢 or 的 do not give the shrug.

items.q: 我早就说过___，这家店最便宜。
items.zh: 我早就说过嘛，这家店最便宜。
items.py: wǒ zǎo jiù shuō guò ma zhè jiā diàn zuì biàn yi
items.en: I told you long ago, didn't I: this shop is the cheapest.
items.why: 嘛 says "you should know this by now", a mild reproach. 吗 would ask whether I said it, but the speaker knows they did.

items.q: 你想吃就吃___，家里又不缺吃的。
items.zh: 你想吃就吃呗，家里又不缺吃的。
items.py: nǐ xiǎng chī jiù chī bei jiā lǐ yòu bù quē chī de
items.en: If you want to eat it, just eat it; it's not as if we're short of food at home.
items.why: 想...就... + 呗 gives a casual "just do it". 吗 would ask a question, and 的 or 呢 do not mean "just".

items.q: 孩子还小___，你别要求他自己洗衣服。
items.zh: 孩子还小嘛，你别要求他自己洗衣服。
items.py: hái zi hái xiǎo ma nǐ bié yào qiú tā zì jǐ xǐ yī fu
items.en: The child is still little, after all; don't demand that he wash his own clothes.
items.why: The speaker is pointing to an obvious reason: 嘛. 吗 would ask whether the child is little, which does not support the advice that follows.

items.q: 这个价钱本来就不高___，不用再砍价了。
items.zh: 这个价钱本来就不高嘛，不用再砍价了。
items.py: zhè gè jià qián běn lái jiù bù gāo ma bù yòng zài kǎn jià le
items.en: This price wasn't high to begin with, so there's no need to bargain any more.
items.why: 本来就 sets up an obvious fact, so the sentence ends with 嘛. 吗 would turn it into a question, and 吧 would turn it into a guess.

items.q: 不喜欢这个颜色就换一个___，店里还有很多别的颜色。
items.zh: 不喜欢这个颜色就换一个呗，店里还有很多别的颜色。
items.py: bù xǐ huan zhè gè yán sè jiù huàn yī gè bei diàn lǐ hái yǒu hěn duō bié de yán sè
items.en: If you don't like this color, just swap it for another; the shop has plenty of other colors.
items.why: ...就... + 呗 treats the fix as obvious and easy. 吗 would ask a question, and 呢 or 的 do not carry the "just do it" attitude.

items.q: 他自己愿意花钱买，你就让他买___，反正是他自己的零花钱。
items.zh: 他自己愿意花钱买，你就让他买呗，反正是他自己的零花钱。
items.py: tā zì jǐ yuàn yì huā qián mǎi nǐ jiù ràng tā mǎi bei fǎn zhèng shì tā zì jǐ de líng huā qián
items.en: If he's willing to spend his own money, just let him buy it; it's his own pocket money anyway.
items.why: 让他买 + 呗 is a casual "just let him". 吗 would ask a question, and 反正 in the next clause shows the speaker is shrugging, not asking.

items.q: 别哭了，爸爸一定会来___。
items.zh: 别哭了，爸爸一定会来的。
items.py: bié kū le bà ba yī dìng huì lái de
items.en: Don't cry; Dad will definitely come.
items.why: 一定会 + 的 is a calm reassurance about the future. 了 would announce that something has changed, and 吗 would ask a question.

items.q: 我保证，这个杯子不会坏___。
items.zh: 我保证，这个杯子不会坏的。
items.py: wǒ bǎo zhèng zhè gè bēi zi bù huì huài de
items.en: I promise, this cup won't break.
items.why: 我保证 asks for a firm assurance: 不会...的. 吧 would soften it to a guess, which clashes with 保证.

items.q: 别担心钱的事，我们家的日子会越来越好___。
items.zh: 别担心钱的事，我们家的日子会越来越好的。
items.py: bié dān xīn qián de shì wǒ men jiā de rì zi huì yuè lái yuè hǎo de
items.en: Don't worry about money; our family's life will get better and better.
items.why: 会...的 gives the listener a calm assurance. 了 would claim it has already happened, and 吧 would make it a guess.

items.q: 你放心，我不会告诉妈妈这件事___。
items.zh: 你放心，我不会告诉妈妈这件事的。
items.py: nǐ fàng xīn wǒ bù huì gào sù mā ma zhè jiàn shì de
items.en: Don't worry, I won't tell Mom about this.
items.why: 不会 + verb + 的 is the promise form. 吧 would weaken a promise to a guess, and 了 does not follow 不会.

items.q: 虽然现在东西很贵，但是你相信我，过几个月价钱一定会降___。
items.zh: 虽然现在东西很贵，但是你相信我，过几个月价钱一定会降的。
items.py: suī rán xiàn zài dōng xi hěn guì dàn shì nǐ xiāng xìn wǒ guò jǐ gè yuè jià qián yī dìng huì jiàng de
items.en: Things are expensive now, but trust me, prices will definitely drop in a few months.
items.why: The speaker is giving a firm assurance about the future: 一定会...的. 了 would report a change that has already happened.

items.q: 你不用担心奶奶，她的病只要好好吃药，很快就会好___。
items.zh: 你不用担心奶奶，她的病只要好好吃药，很快就会好的。
items.py: nǐ bù yòng dān xīn nǎi nai tā de bìng zhǐ yào hǎo hǎo chī yào hěn kuài jiù huì hǎo de
items.en: No need to worry about Grandma; as long as she takes her medicine, she will soon be well.
items.why: 会好 + 的 is the reassurance. 吧 would turn the comfort into a doubtful guess, and 吗 would ask a question.

items.q: 我已经不想买手机___。
items.zh: 我已经不想买手机了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng bù xiǎng mǎi shǒu jī le
items.en: I don't want to buy a phone any more.
items.why: 不想...了 means "not any more", a change from before. 呢 would mean it is still so, and 吗 would ask a question.

items.q: 弟弟现在有手机___。
items.zh: 弟弟现在有手机了。
items.py: dì di xiàn zài yǒu shǒu jī le
items.en: My younger brother has a phone now.
items.why: 现在 plus final 了 marks a new situation: he did not have one before. 吗 would ask a question, and 的 does not report a change.

items.q: 这家店现在不打折___，你来晚了。
items.zh: 这家店现在不打折了，你来晚了。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn xiàn zài bù dǎ zhé le nǐ lái wǎn le
items.en: This shop isn't having sales any more; you came too late.
items.why: 不打折了 means the discounts have stopped, a change from before. 呢 would say they still are not on, but 来晚了 shows a change.

items.q: 我的钱包里没有钱___，得去银行取一点。
items.zh: 我的钱包里没有钱了，得去银行取一点。
items.py: wǒ de qián bāo lǐ méi yǒu qián le děi qù yín xíng qǔ yī diǎn
items.en: There's no money left in my wallet now; I have to withdraw some at the bank.
items.why: 没有钱了 means money that used to be there is gone, a change. 吗 would ask a question, and 的 does not report a change.

items.q: 孩子们都长大___，不再需要我们每天接送了。
items.zh: 孩子们都长大了，不再需要我们每天接送了。
items.py: hái zi men dōu zhǎng dà le bù zài xū yào wǒ men měi tiān jiē sòng le
items.en: The children have all grown up and no longer need us to take them to and from school every day.
items.why: Final 了 says the change has happened: they are grown now. 呢 would say they are still growing, which contradicts 不再需要.

items.q: 他现在是我们小区最大的超市老板___，过去只是个小店员。
items.zh: 他现在是我们小区最大的超市老板了，过去只是个小店员。
items.py: tā xiàn zài shì wǒ men xiǎo qū zuì dà de chāo shì lǎo bǎn le guò qù zhǐ shì gè xiǎo diàn yuán
items.en: He is now the owner of the biggest supermarket in our neighborhood; in the past he was just a small clerk.
items.why: 现在 and 过去 set up a before-and-after, so the new state takes 了. 吗 would ask a question, and 的 or 呗 do not mark a change.

items.zh: 我们一起回家吧。
items.py: wǒ men yī qǐ huí jiā ba
items.en: Let's go home together.
items.why: 吧 closes the suggestion after the whole action 一起回家; 一起 must stay in front of 回家.

items.zh: 爷爷还没起床呢。
items.py: yé ye hái méi qǐ chuáng ne
items.en: Grandpa hasn't got up yet.
items.why: 还没 comes right before the verb and 呢 closes the sentence, giving "still the case".

items.zh: 你喜欢这件衣服吗？
items.py: nǐ xǐ huan zhè jiàn yī fu ma
items.en: Do you like this piece of clothing?
items.why: 吗 always goes at the very end. The object may be moved to the front as a topic, and that order is also correct.

items.zh: 我的钱包呢？
items.py: wǒ de qián bāo ne
items.en: Where is my wallet?
items.why: Noun + 呢 asks where something is. The particle must be last, after the whole noun phrase.

items.zh: 你一定早就知道这个价钱了吧。
items.py: nǐ yī dìng zǎo jiù zhī dào zhè gè jià qián le ba
items.en: You must have known this price long ago, I take it?
items.why: 了 comes before 吧 because 吧 is the last word of the sentence. 一定 comes before 早就, and the object can be fronted as a topic.

items.task: Turn it into a yes/no question.
items.zh: 你想喝茶吗？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng hē chá ma
items.en: Do you want to drink tea?
items.why: Add 吗 at the end of the statement; nothing else moves.

items.task: Soften it into a gentle suggestion.
items.zh: 你多喝点水吧。
items.py: nǐ duō hē diǎn shuǐ ba
items.en: Why don't you drink a bit more water.
items.why: 吧 at the end turns the instruction into a friendly suggestion.

items.task: Say he is sleeping right now.
items.zh: 弟弟在睡觉呢。
items.py: dì di zài shuì jué ne
items.en: My younger brother is sleeping.
items.why: 在 before the verb and 呢 at the end mark an action going on right now.

items.src_py: wǒ bù xiǎng mǎi nà tái jiù diàn shì
items.task: Say you don't want to buy it any more.
items.zh: 我不想买那台旧电视了。
items.py: wǒ bù xiǎng mǎi nà tái jiù diàn shì le
items.en: I don't want to buy that old TV any more.
items.why: 不想...了 means "not any more". The object can also be fronted as a topic, so both orders are right.

items.src_py: yé ye de bìng huì hǎo
items.task: Reassure the listener with 一定 and a final particle.
items.zh: 别担心，爷爷的病一定会好的。
items.py: bié dān xīn yé ye de bìng yī dìng huì hǎo de
items.en: Don't worry, Grandpa will definitely get better.
items.why: 一定会...的 gives a firm reassurance; 一定 sits before 会 and 的 ends the sentence.

items.s_py: nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén ma
items.zh: 你家有几口人？
items.py: nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén
items.en: How many people are in your family?
items.why: 几 asks for a number, so the sentence is already a question and cannot take 吗.

items.s_py: zhè gè bēi zi nǐ yào bù yào ma
items.zh: 这个杯子你要不要？
items.py: zhè gè bēi zi nǐ yào bù yào
items.en: Do you want this cup or not?
items.why: 要不要 is an A-not-A question, so 吗 cannot be added.

items.s: 你想知道这件衣服多少钱吗？
items.s_py: nǐ xiǎng zhī dào zhè jiàn yī fu duō shǎo qián ma
items.zh: 你想知道这件衣服多少钱吗？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng zhī dào zhè jiàn yī fu duō shǎo qián ma
items.en: Do you want to know how much this piece of clothing costs?
items.why: 多少钱 sits inside the clause after 想知道, so the whole sentence is a yes/no question and 吗 is right.

items.s_py: nǐ shì bà ba de péng you ne
items.zh: 你是爸爸的朋友吗？
items.py: nǐ shì bà ba de péng you ma
items.en: Are you Dad's friend?
items.why: 呢 cannot turn a statement into a yes/no question; that is the job of 吗.

items.s_py: nǐ men dào dǐ mǎi bù mǎi ne
items.zh: 你们到底买不买呢？
items.py: nǐ men dào dǐ mǎi bù mǎi ne
items.en: So are you buying or not?
items.why: 呢 is allowed after a question that already is one (买不买), and it makes the question sound impatient.

items.s_py: nǐ wèi shén me bù mǎi ma
items.zh: 你为什么不买呢？
items.py: nǐ wèi shén me bù mǎi ne
items.en: Why aren't you buying it?
items.why: 为什么 already makes this a question, so 吗 is impossible; 呢 is the particle that can soften it.

items.s_py: wài miàn hái xià zhe dà yǔ ne
items.zh: 外面还下着大雨呢。
items.py: wài miàn hái xià zhe dà yǔ ne
items.en: It's still pouring outside.
items.why: Verb + 着 + 呢 describes a state that is going on right now, so this sentence is correct.

items.s: 现在才五点了，你再睡一会儿。
items.s_py: xiàn zài cái wǔ diǎn le nǐ zài shuì yī huì r
items.zh: 现在才五点呢，你再睡一会儿。
items.py: xiàn zài cái wǔ diǎn ne nǐ zài shuì yī huì r
items.en: It's only five o'clock; sleep a little longer.
items.why: 才 stresses "only", the situation has not changed, so 了 fails; 才...呢 is the right pattern.

items.s: 时间不早了，我们快点去超市吗。
items.s_py: shí jiān bù zǎo le wǒ men kuài diǎn qù chāo shì ma
items.zh: 时间不早了，我们快点去超市吧。
items.py: shí jiān bù zǎo le wǒ men kuài diǎn qù chāo shì ba
items.en: It's getting late; let's hurry to the supermarket.
items.why: "Let's" is a proposal, which needs 吧; 吗 would ask a question and cannot end a statement with a full stop.

items.s: 这个价钱太高了，我们再看看别的吧。
items.s_py: zhè gè jià qián tài gāo le wǒ men zài kàn kàn bié de ba
items.zh: 这个价钱太高了，我们再看看别的吧。
items.py: zhè gè jià qián tài gāo le wǒ men zài kàn kàn bié de ba
items.en: This price is too high; let's look at other ones.
items.why: 吧 closes a proposal, so the sentence is correct.

items.s_py: hǎo ba wǒ men jiù mǎi zhè gè
items.zh: 好吧，我们就买这个。
items.py: hǎo ba wǒ men jiù mǎi zhè gè
items.en: All right, let's buy this one then.
items.why: 好吧 means giving in, and it is a set phrase here.

items.s_py: nǐ shì xiǎo lǐ de jiě jie ba ma
items.zh: 你是小李的姐姐吧？
items.py: nǐ shì xiǎo lǐ de jiě jie ba
items.en: You're Xiao Li's older sister, right?
items.why: 吧 and 吗 are never used together; 吧 alone fits a guess.

items.s: 你不是第一次来这家店吧？
items.s_py: nǐ bù shì dì yī cì lái zhè jiā diàn ba
items.zh: 你不是第一次来这家店吧？
items.py: nǐ bù shì dì yī cì lái zhè jiā diàn ba
items.en: This isn't your first time in this shop, I suppose?
items.why: Negative statement + 吧 asks for confirmation of a guess; the sentence is correct.

items.s_py: zhè gè fáng jiān duō gàn jìng ma
items.zh: 这个房间多干净啊！
items.py: zhè gè fáng jiān duō gàn jìng a
items.en: How clean this room is!
items.why: 多...! is an exclamation and needs 啊; 吗 makes a yes/no question and cannot end an exclamation.

items.s: 你快说啊，到底花了多少钱？
items.s_py: nǐ kuài shuō a dào dǐ huā le duō shǎo qián
items.zh: 你快说啊，到底花了多少钱？
items.py: nǐ kuài shuō a dào dǐ huā le duō shǎo qián
items.en: Come on, say it; how much did you spend in the end?
items.why: 啊 adds urging, and 多少钱 is the question; 啊 does not turn it into a yes/no question.

items.s: 他还是个孩子嘛，别太严格。
items.s_py: tā hái shì gè hái zi ma bié tài yán gé
items.zh: 他还是个孩子嘛，别太严格。
items.py: tā hái shì gè hái zi ma bié tài yán gé
items.en: He's still a child, after all; don't be too strict.
items.why: 嘛 states the obvious reason, so the sentence is correct.

items.s: 你想买就买呗，反正是你自己的钱。
items.s_py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi jiù mǎi bei fǎn zhèng shì nǐ zì jǐ de qián
items.zh: 你想买就买呗，反正是你自己的钱。
items.py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi jiù mǎi bei fǎn zhèng shì nǐ zì jǐ de qián
items.en: If you want to buy it, just buy it; it's your own money anyway.
items.why: 就...呗 gives a casual "just do it", so the sentence is correct.

items.s: 别担心，他一定会回来了。
items.s_py: bié dān xīn tā yī dìng huì huí lái le
items.zh: 别担心，他一定会回来的。
items.py: bié dān xīn tā yī dìng huì huí lái de
items.en: Don't worry, he will definitely come back.
items.why: 一定会 looks to the future, so it takes the assuring 的; 了 reports a change and cannot follow 一定会.

items.s: 我不会把这件事告诉别人的。
items.s_py: wǒ bù huì bǎ zhè jiàn shì gào sù bié rén de
items.zh: 我不会把这件事告诉别人的。
items.py: wǒ bù huì bǎ zhè jiàn shì gào sù bié rén de
items.en: I won't tell anyone about this.
items.why: 不会...的 is a promise, so the sentence is correct.

items.s: 我的手机坏呢，我得买一个新的。
items.s_py: wǒ de shǒu jī huài ne wǒ děi mǎi yī gè xīn de
items.zh: 我的手机坏了，我得买一个新的。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī huài le wǒ děi mǎi yī gè xīn de
items.en: My phone is broken now; I have to buy a new one.
items.why: 坏 reports a new state, which needs 了, not 呢.

items.s: 妈妈今天不做饭了，我们去外面吃。
items.s_py: mā ma jīn tiān bù zuò fàn le wǒ men qù wài miàn chī
items.zh: 妈妈今天不做饭了，我们去外面吃。
items.py: mā ma jīn tiān bù zuò fàn le wǒ men qù wài miàn chī
items.en: Mom isn't cooking today after all; we'll eat out.
items.why: 不...了 marks a changed plan, so the sentence is correct.

items.q: 你今天头疼___？
items.zh: 你今天头疼吗？
items.py: nǐ jīn tiān tóu téng ma
items.why: A plain statement becomes a neutral yes/no question with 吗. 呢 only follows a noun or an existing question, and 嘛 states the obvious instead of asking.
items.en: Do you have a headache today?

items.q: 你哪儿不舒服___？
items.zh: 你哪儿不舒服？
items.py: nǐ nǎ r bù shū fu
items.why: 哪儿 already makes this a question asking for information, so no 吗 or 吧 may be added. The blank stays empty.
items.en: Where do you feel unwell?

items.q: 你昨天晚上睡得好不好___？
items.zh: 你昨天晚上睡得好不好？
items.py: nǐ zuó tiān wǎn shang shuì de hǎo bù hǎo
items.why: 睡得好不好 is an A-not-A question, which is already complete. Adding 吗 doubles the question, and 吧 would turn it into a guess.
items.en: Did you sleep well last night?

items.q: 我刚搬来这儿，这里的冬天比北京冷___？
items.zh: 我刚搬来这儿，这里的冬天比北京冷吗？
items.py: wǒ gāng bān lái zhè r zhè lǐ de dōng tiān bǐ běi jīng lěng ma
items.why: A plain yes/no question about a statement takes 吗. 呢 cannot turn a statement into a question, and 嘛 would claim the answer is obvious, which fits a newcomer who is asking.
items.en: I just moved here. Is the winter here colder than in Beijing?

items.q: 医生，我这个病需要住院___？
items.zh: 医生，我这个病需要住院吗？
items.py: yī shēng wǒ zhè ge bìng xū yào zhù yuàn ma
items.why: A yes/no question about a statement needs 吗. 呢 cannot turn a statement into a question, and 嘛 would insist the answer is obvious.
items.en: Doctor, do I need to be admitted to hospital?

items.q: 你们那儿的冬天会下雪___？
items.zh: 你们那儿的冬天会下雪吗？
items.py: nǐ men nà r de dōng tiān huì xià xuě ma
items.why: A plain statement that is asked as a neutral yes/no question takes 吗. 呢 cannot make a statement into a question, and 嘛 would say the answer is obvious instead of asking.
items.en: Does it snow in winter where you are?

items.q: 你知道医院附近哪儿有药店___？
items.zh: 你知道医院附近哪儿有药店吗？
items.py: nǐ zhī dào yī yuàn fù jìn nǎ r yǒu yào diàn ma
items.why: Here 哪儿 sits inside 知道, so the sentence asks only yes or no and takes 吗. 呢 cannot make a yes/no question, and 吧 would turn it into a guess.
items.en: Do you know where there is a pharmacy near the hospital?

items.q: 你感冒___吗？
items.zh: 你感冒了吗？
items.py: nǐ gǎn mào le ma
items.why: Asking whether something has happened keeps the 了 inside the statement and adds 吗 at the end. The other particles cannot sit before 吗 here.
items.en: Have you caught a cold?

items.q: 我有点儿头疼，你___？
items.zh: 我有点儿头疼，你呢？
items.py: wǒ yǒu diǎn r tóu téng nǐ ne
items.why: Bouncing the question back with a bare pronoun is 你呢. 你吗 is not said because 吗 needs a full statement before it.
items.en: I have a bit of a headache. What about you?

items.q: 我的雨伞___？
items.zh: 我的雨伞呢？
items.py: wǒ de yǔ sǎn ne
items.why: A noun alone plus 呢 asks where it is. 吗 would need a complete statement.
items.en: Where is my umbrella?

items.q: 今天下雨，明天___？
items.zh: 今天下雨，明天呢？
items.py: jīn tiān xià yǔ míng tiān ne
items.why: Following up with a bare noun asks the same question about tomorrow, which is 明天呢. 吧 would be a guess about tomorrow.
items.en: It is raining today. What about tomorrow?

items.q: 春天很短，你们那儿的秋天___？
items.zh: 春天很短，你们那儿的秋天呢？
items.py: chūn tiān hěn duǎn nǐ men nà r de qiū tiān ne
items.why: A topic phrase with no verb that asks about another item in the same frame takes 呢. 吗 would need a full clause like 秋天也很短吗.
items.en: Spring is short. What about autumn where you are?

items.q: 这么冷的天，你怎么还穿短袖___？
items.zh: 这么冷的天，你怎么还穿短袖呢？
items.py: zhè me lěng de tiān nǐ zěn me hái chuān duǎn xiù ne
items.why: 怎么 makes this a question already, so 吗 and 吧 are impossible. 呢 only softens it and adds the speaker's puzzlement.
items.en: It is so cold. Why are you still in short sleeves?

items.q: 医生让你每天吃几次药___？
items.zh: 医生让你每天吃几次药呢？
items.py: yī shēng ràng nǐ měi tiān chī jǐ cì yào ne
items.why: 几次 is a question word, so 吗 cannot follow. 吧 would turn it into a guess. Only 呢 can soften an existing question.
items.en: How many times a day did the doctor tell you to take the medicine?

items.q: 要是明天还下雨，我们的运动会该怎么办___？
items.zh: 要是明天还下雨，我们的运动会该怎么办呢？
items.py: yào shi míng tiān hái xià yǔ wǒ men de yùn dòng huì gāi zěn me bàn ne
items.why: The question word 怎么办 already asks, so 吗 is out and 吧 would turn it into a suggestion. 呢 gives the worried tone of a thinking-aloud question.
items.en: If it still rains tomorrow, what are we going to do about the sports day?

items.q: 你到底是头疼还是肚子疼___？
items.zh: 你到底是头疼还是肚子疼呢？
items.py: nǐ dào dǐ shì tóu téng hái shi dù zi téng ne
items.why: 还是 offers a choice, so the sentence is already a question and 吗 is ungrammatical. 呢 adds the impatient tone of 到底.
items.en: Is it your head or your stomach that hurts, exactly?

items.q: 别进去，医生在看病___。
items.zh: 别进去，医生在看病呢。
items.py: bié jìn qù yī shēng zài kàn bìng ne
items.why: 在 + verb shows an action in progress, and 呢 points out that this is the situation right now. 吗 would ask a question and 吧 would turn it into a guess.
items.en: Do not go in; the doctor is seeing a patient.

items.q: 我还没吃药___。
items.zh: 我还没吃药呢。
items.py: wǒ hái méi chī yào ne
items.why: 还没 means nothing has happened yet, so 了 is impossible. 呢 marks that this is still the situation.
items.en: I have not taken my medicine yet.

items.q: 外面刮着大风___。
items.zh: 外面刮着大风呢。
items.py: wài miàn guā zhe dà fēng ne
items.why: 着 shows a continuing state and 呢 stresses that it is going on now. 的 would be an assurance and 吗 a question.
items.en: It is blowing a gale outside.

items.q: 现在才十月___，怎么就穿羽绒服了？
items.zh: 现在才十月呢，怎么就穿羽绒服了？
items.py: xiàn zài cái shí yuè ne zěn me jiù chuān yǔ róng fú le
items.why: 才 + time + 呢 stresses that it is early, against the listener's assumption. 了 cannot follow 才十月, and 吗 and 吧 do not fit.
items.en: It is only October. Why are you in a down jacket already?

items.q: 他还没退烧___，不能去上学。
items.zh: 他还没退烧呢，不能去上学。
items.py: tā hái méi tuì shāo ne bù néng qù shàng xué
items.why: 还没 + verb + 呢 says the situation has not changed. 了 contradicts 还没, and 吧 would turn a fact into a guess.
items.en: His fever has not come down yet, so he cannot go to school.

items.q: 我正在量体温___，你等一下。
items.zh: 我正在量体温呢，你等一下。
items.py: wǒ zhèng zài liáng tǐ wēn ne nǐ děng yī xià
items.why: 正在 marks an action in progress and 呢 closes it as how things stand now. 吧 would suggest something rather than describe it.
items.en: I am taking my temperature right now; wait a moment.

items.q: 山上还下着雪___，路不好走。
items.zh: 山上还下着雪呢，路不好走。
items.py: shān shàng hái xià zhe xuě ne lù bù hǎo zǒu
items.why: 着 and 还 show the snow continues, and 呢 stresses that it is still so. 了 would announce a new change, and 吗 asks.
items.en: It is still snowing up in the mountains, so the road is hard to walk.

items.q: 这点儿雨算什么？我才不怕___！
items.zh: 这点儿雨算什么？我才不怕呢！
items.py: zhè diǎn r yǔ suàn shén me wǒ cái bù pà ne
items.why: 才不...呢 is the strong denial: "I certainly do not". 了 would mean the fear has just stopped, which is not the idea here.
items.en: What is a bit of rain? I am certainly not afraid!

items.q: 现在是三伏天，最热的时候还没到___，你就受不了了？
items.zh: 现在是三伏天，最热的时候还没到呢，你就受不了了？
items.py: xiàn zài shì sān fú tiān zuì rè de shí hou hái méi dào ne nǐ jiù shòu bù liǎo le
items.why: 还没到 means not yet, so the clause takes 呢 and never 了. 吗 would turn the clause into a question in the middle of a sentence.
items.en: It is the dog days, but the hottest time has not even come yet, and you cannot stand it already?

items.q: 医生说他的病还没好___，你怎么能让他出门吹风？
items.zh: 医生说他的病还没好呢，你怎么能让他出门吹风？
items.py: yī shēng shuō tā de bìng hái méi hǎo ne nǐ zěn me néng ràng tā chū mén chuī fēng
items.why: 还没好 describes a state that has not changed, which is 呢. 了 would say he has recovered, and the following reproach would make no sense.
items.en: The doctor said he is not better yet, so how can you let him go out in the wind?

items.q: 天冷了，你多穿一件衣服___。
items.zh: 天冷了，你多穿一件衣服吧。
items.py: tiān lěng le nǐ duō chuān yī jiàn yī fu ba
items.why: A friendly instruction softened into advice takes 吧. 吗 would ask whether you put one on.
items.en: It is cold; put on another layer.

items.q: 我们去公园走走___。
items.zh: 我们去公园走走吧。
items.py: wǒ men qù gōng yuán zǒu zou ba
items.why: "Let us" is a proposal, so 吧 is needed. 我们去公园走走吗 would ask if the plan exists, not propose it.
items.en: Let us take a walk in the park.

items.q: 你感冒了，今天请假在家休息___。
items.zh: 你感冒了，今天请假在家休息吧。
items.py: nǐ gǎn mào le jīn tiān qǐng jià zài jiā xiū xi ba
items.why: Advice to do something is 吧. 吗 would ask whether you are taking leave, and 呢 describes a state instead of advising.
items.en: You have a cold; take the day off and rest at home.

items.q: 雨太大了，我们等雨停了再走___。
items.zh: 雨太大了，我们等雨停了再走吧。
items.py: yǔ tài dà le wǒ men děng yǔ tíng le zài zǒu ba
items.why: "Let us wait and then go" is a proposal, which 吧 marks. 吗 would ask a factual question about the plan.
items.en: The rain is too heavy; let us wait until it stops before leaving.

items.q: 我真不想去医院，不过你说得对。好___，我明天就去。
items.zh: 我真不想去医院，不过你说得对。好吧，我明天就去。
items.py: wǒ zhēn bù xiǎng qù yī yuàn bú guò nǐ shuō de duì hǎo ba wǒ míng tiān jiù qù
items.why: 好吧 means giving in reluctantly after resistance. 好啊 would sound eager and does not match 我真不想去.
items.en: I really do not want to go to the hospital, but you are right. All right then, I will go tomorrow.

items.q: 这个药很苦，你捏着鼻子一口喝下去___。
items.zh: 这个药很苦，你捏着鼻子一口喝下去吧。
items.py: zhè ge yào hěn kǔ nǐ niē zhe bí zi yī kǒu hē xià qù ba
