items.why: A gentle instruction is softened with 吧. 吗 would ask a question and 的 gives an assurance about the future, neither of which fits an order.
items.en: This medicine is bitter; hold your nose and drink it down in one go.

items.q: 明天的天气预报说有大雨，我们把爬山的计划改到下个周末___。
items.zh: 明天的天气预报说有大雨，我们把爬山的计划改到下个周末吧。
items.py: míng tiān de tiān qì yù bào shuō yǒu dà yǔ wǒ men bǎ pá shān de jì huà gǎi dào xià ge zhōu mò ba
items.why: Proposing a change to the plan is 吧. 了 would report that the change has already been made, which a proposal does not do.
items.en: The forecast says heavy rain tomorrow; let us move the hiking plan to next weekend.

items.q: 你已经咳嗽一个星期了，别再拖了，今天下午就去看医生___。
items.zh: 你已经咳嗽一个星期了，别再拖了，今天下午就去看医生吧。
items.py: nǐ yǐ jīng ké sou yī gè xīng qī le bié zài tuō le jīn tiān xià wǔ jiù qù kàn yī shēng ba
items.why: After "stop putting it off" the sentence urges an action, so it ends in 吧. 吗 would ask whether you are going.
items.en: You have been coughing for a week; stop putting it off and go and see a doctor this afternoon.

items.q: 你的脸很红，你发烧了___？
items.zh: 你的脸很红，你发烧了吧？
items.py: nǐ de liǎn hěn hóng nǐ fā shāo le ba
items.why: The red face gives the speaker a guess and the 吧 seeks confirmation. Neutral 吗 would ignore the evidence the speaker already has.
items.en: Your face is very red; you have a fever, haven't you?

items.q: 今天好冷，你也觉得冷___？
items.zh: 今天好冷，你也觉得冷吧？
items.py: jīn tiān hǎo lěng nǐ yě jué de lěng ba
items.why: The speaker feels cold and expects agreement, which is 吧. 嘛 would say it is obvious rather than seek agreement.
items.en: It is so cold today; you think so too, right?

items.q: 他大概感冒了___，一直在咳嗽。
items.zh: 他大概感冒了吧，一直在咳嗽。
items.py: tā dà gài gǎn mào le ba yī zhí zài ké sou
items.why: 大概 shows a guess, and 吧 marks the guess. 吗 asks a neutral question and cannot go with 大概 in a statement.
items.en: He has probably caught a cold, I suppose; he keeps coughing.

items.q: 这个周末应该不会下雨了___？
items.zh: 这个周末应该不会下雨了吧？
items.py: zhè ge zhōu mò yīng gāi bú huì xià yǔ le ba
items.why: 应该 shows the speaker expects a certain answer, which is what 吧 seeks to confirm. 吗 would be a neutral question without that expectation.
items.en: It should not rain this weekend, should it?

items.q: 你每天都跑步，身体一定很好___？
items.zh: 你每天都跑步，身体一定很好吧？
items.py: nǐ měi tiān dōu pǎo bù shēn tǐ yī dìng hěn hǎo ba
items.why: 一定 shows the speaker is already sure and only wants agreement, so 吧. 吗 would show no opinion at all.
items.en: You run every day, so you must be very healthy, I suppose?

items.q: 你的腿疼了好几天了，你一定没有好好休息___？
items.zh: 你的腿疼了好几天了，你一定没有好好休息吧？
items.py: nǐ de tuǐ téng le hǎo jǐ tiān le nǐ yī dìng méi yǒu hǎo hǎo xiū xi ba
items.why: 一定 plus the visible evidence makes this a presumption, so 吧. 吗 would suggest the speaker has no idea either way.
items.en: Your leg has hurt for days; you surely have not been resting properly, have you?

items.q: 我看你脸色不太好，昨天晚上大概没睡好___？
items.zh: 我看你脸色不太好，昨天晚上大概没睡好吧？
items.py: wǒ kàn nǐ liǎn sè bú tài hǎo zuó tiān wǎn shang dà gài méi shuì hǎo ba
items.why: 大概 and the speaker's observation mark this as a guess to be confirmed: 吧. 了 cannot follow 没睡好 when the point is a guess.
items.en: You do not look well; you probably did not sleep well last night, I take it?

items.q: 今年夏天比去年热得多，空调的电费应该不便宜___？
items.zh: 今年夏天比去年热得多，空调的电费应该不便宜吧？
items.py: jīn nián xià tiān bǐ qù nián rè de duō kōng tiáo de diàn fèi yīng gāi bù pián yi ba
items.why: 应该 plus the reasoning from the hot weather is a presumption to confirm, so 吧. 吗 would ignore that reasoning.
items.en: This summer is much hotter than last year; the air-conditioning bill must be steep, I suppose?

items.q: 今天的天气多好___！
items.zh: 今天的天气多好啊！
items.py: jīn tiān de tiān qì duō hǎo a
items.why: 多 + adjective makes an exclamation and 啊 adds the warmth. 吗 would turn it into a question and 吧 into a guess.
items.en: What lovely weather today!

items.q: 雪下得真大___！
items.zh: 雪下得真大啊！
items.py: xuě xià de zhēn dà a
items.why: 真 + adjective is an exclamation, and 啊 gives it feeling. 吗 and 吧 would change the sentence type.
items.en: It is snowing so hard!

items.q: 快穿上外套___，外面很冷！
items.zh: 快穿上外套啊，外面很冷！
items.py: kuài chuān shàng wài tào a wài miàn hěn lěng
items.why: A friendly urging is warmed by 啊. 吗 would ask a question and 呢 describes ongoing action rather than urges.
items.en: Hurry and put on your coat; it is cold outside!

items.q: 今年的秋天真舒服。——是___，比往年凉快多了。
items.zh: 今年的秋天真舒服。——是啊，比往年凉快多了。
items.py: jīn nián de qiū tiān zhēn shū fu shì a bǐ wǎng nián liáng kuai duō le
items.why: 是啊 is warm agreement. 是吗 would mean "is that so?", the speaker does not know, which contradicts the reply that follows.
items.en: "This autumn is really pleasant." "Yes, it is much cooler than in previous years."

items.q: 您多保重身体___，别太累了！
items.zh: 您多保重身体啊，别太累了！
items.py: nín duō bǎo zhòng shēn tǐ a bié tài lèi le
items.why: A caring farewell with a request is warmed by 啊. 吗 would ask a question and 呢 would describe a continuing state.
items.en: Take good care of yourself and do not get too tired!

items.q: 你看，雨后的空气多新鲜___，咱们出去走走吧！
items.zh: 你看，雨后的空气多新鲜啊，咱们出去走走吧！
items.py: nǐ kàn yǔ hòu de kōng qì duō xīn xiān a zán men chū qù zǒu zou ba
items.why: 多 + adjective is an exclamation, so the clause ends in 啊. 吗 would ask whether it is fresh and 吧 would make a guess.
items.en: Look, how fresh the air is after the rain! Let us go out for a walk.

items.q: 能在这么热的天气里喝上一杯冰水，真是舒服___！
items.zh: 能在这么热的天气里喝上一杯冰水，真是舒服啊！
items.py: néng zài zhè me rè de tiān qì lǐ hē shàng yī bēi bīng shuǐ zhēn shi shū fu a
items.why: 真是 + adjective is a heartfelt exclamation, which 啊 colours. 吗 and 吧 would turn it into a question or a guess.
items.en: What a pleasure to have a glass of iced water in such hot weather!

items.q: 生病了当然要吃药___。
items.zh: 生病了当然要吃药嘛。
items.py: shēng bìng le dāng rán yào chī yào ma
items.why: 当然 says this is obvious, and 嘛 carries "as everyone knows". 吗 would ask a question, which clashes with 当然.
items.en: Of course you have to take medicine when you are ill.

items.q: 冷就多穿点___。
items.zh: 冷就多穿点呗。
items.py: lěng jiù duō chuān diǎn bei
items.why: 就...呗 says the fix is simple, so just do it. 吗 would ask whether you wear more.
items.en: If you are cold, just put on more.

items.q: 他才五岁___，生病了当然会哭。
items.zh: 他才五岁嘛，生病了当然会哭。
items.py: tā cái wǔ suì ma shēng bìng le dāng rán huì kū
items.why: 嘛 points to an obvious reason ("he is only five, after all"). 吗 would ask how old he is, and the clause is meant as a reason.
items.en: He is only five, after all; of course he cries when he is ill.

items.q: 下雨就下雨___，我们有雨伞，怕什么。
items.zh: 下雨就下雨呗，我们有雨伞，怕什么。
items.py: xià yǔ jiù xià yǔ bei wǒ men yǒu yǔ sǎn pà shén me
items.why: X 就 X 呗 means 'so be it' with a shrug, and 怕什么 backs it up. 吗 would make it a question, 呢 would claim it is still going on, and 的 is a promise about the future.
items.en: If it rains, then it rains. We have umbrellas, so what is there to fear?

items.q: 医生早就说过了___，抽烟对身体不好。
items.zh: 医生早就说过了嘛，抽烟对身体不好。
items.py: yī shēng zǎo jiù shuō guo le ma chōu yān duì shēn tǐ bù hǎo
items.why: 嘛 reminds the listener of something they should already know. 吗 would ask whether the doctor said it, which the clause after contradicts.
items.en: The doctor said so long ago, you know: smoking is bad for your health.

items.q: 睡不着就别睡___，起来看会儿书，反正明天不用上班。
items.zh: 睡不着就别睡呗，起来看会儿书，反正明天不用上班。
items.py: shuì bù zháo jiù bié shuì bei qǐ lái kàn huì r shū fǎn zhèng míng tiān bú yòng shàng bān
items.why: 就...呗 with 反正 gives the 'no big deal, just do it' attitude. 吗 would turn the clause into a question, and 的 would be a promise about the future.
items.en: If you cannot sleep, then do not sleep; get up and read a while, since you do not have to work tomorrow.

items.q: 夏天本来就热___，你别老抱怨天气，开着空调就是了。
items.zh: 夏天本来就热嘛，你别老抱怨天气，开着空调就是了。
items.py: xià tiān běn lái jiù rè ma nǐ bié lǎo bào yuàn tiān qì kāi zhe kōng tiáo jiù shì le
items.why: 本来就 states the obvious, so 嘛 fits. 吗 would ask whether summer is hot, and the clause then makes no sense.
items.en: Summer is hot by nature, after all; stop always complaining about the weather and just keep the air conditioning on.

items.q: 你自己都说不舒服了，那就去医院看看___，别在这儿犹豫了。
items.zh: 你自己都说不舒服了，那就去医院看看呗，别在这儿犹豫了。
items.py: nǐ zì jǐ dōu shuō bù shū fu le nà jiù qù yī yuàn kàn kan bei bié zài zhè r yóu yù le
items.why: 那就...呗 treats going as the obvious simple answer. 吗 would ask whether you will go, which clashes with the order that follows.
items.en: You said yourself you feel unwell, so just go and have it checked at the hospital; stop hesitating.

items.q: 别担心，你的病会好___。
items.zh: 别担心，你的病会好的。
items.py: bié dān xīn nǐ de bìng huì hǎo de
items.why: 会 + verb + 的 gives a calm assurance about the future. 了 reports a change that has already happened.
items.en: Do not worry, you will get better.

items.q: 你放心，明天一定会放晴___。
items.zh: 你放心，明天一定会放晴的。
items.py: nǐ fàng xīn míng tiān yī dìng huì fàng qíng de
items.why: 一定会...的 is a confident promise. 吧 would make it a mere guess and 了 would claim it has already happened.
items.en: Rest assured, it will definitely clear up tomorrow.

items.q: 吃了药，烧一定会退___，别着急。
items.zh: 吃了药，烧一定会退的，别着急。
items.py: chī le yào shāo yī dìng huì tuì de bié zháo jí
items.why: 一定会...的 is a confident reassurance about the future. 了 reports a change already made and clashes with 一定会, and 吧 would turn the promise into a guess.
items.en: Once you take the medicine, the fever will definitely go down, so do not worry.

items.q: 我不会忘记吃药___，你不用提醒我。
items.zh: 我不会忘记吃药的，你不用提醒我。
items.py: wǒ bú huì wàng jì chī yào de nǐ bú yòng tí xǐng wǒ
items.why: 不会...的 is a promise that something will not happen. 吧 would turn the promise into a guess.
items.en: I will not forget to take my medicine; you do not need to remind me.

items.q: 台风一定会很快过去___，大家不要太紧张。
items.zh: 台风一定会很快过去的，大家不要太紧张。
items.py: tái fēng yī dìng huì hěn kuài guò qù de dà jiā bú yào tài jǐn zhāng
items.why: The speaker reassures the group about the future with 一定会...的. 了 would say it has already passed, and 吧 would turn the promise into a guess.
items.en: The typhoon will definitely pass soon, so everyone, do not be too nervous.

items.q: 医生说手术很安全，你妈妈一定不会有事___，别一个人在这儿哭了。
items.zh: 医生说手术很安全，你妈妈一定不会有事的，别一个人在这儿哭了。
items.py: yī shēng shuō shǒu shù hěn ān quán nǐ mā ma yī dìng bú huì yǒu shì de bié yī gè rén zài zhè r kū le
items.why: 一定不会...的 comforts the listener with certainty. 吧 would make the comfort a weak guess and defeat the reassurance.
items.en: The doctor said the operation is very safe, so your mother will surely be fine; stop crying here alone.

items.q: 我的头不疼___。
items.zh: 我的头不疼了。
items.py: wǒ de tóu bù téng le
items.why: 不 + verb + 了 means "not any more", a change from before. 呢 would say it still hurts.
items.en: My head does not hurt any more.

items.q: 天晴___，我们出去玩吧。
items.zh: 天晴了，我们出去玩吧。
items.py: tiān qíng le wǒ men chū qù wán ba
items.why: The weather has changed from before, which 了 marks. 呢 would say it is still sunny as before.
items.en: The sky has cleared; let us go out to play.

items.q: 她已经不咳嗽___，明天可以上学。
items.zh: 她已经不咳嗽了，明天可以上学。
items.py: tā yǐ jīng bù ké sou le míng tiān kě yǐ shàng xué
items.why: 已经不 + verb needs 了 for "not any more". 的 would be a promise about the future, which is not the point.
items.en: She does not cough any more, so she can go to school tomorrow.

items.q: 秋天到了，树叶都黄___。
items.zh: 秋天到了，树叶都黄了。
items.py: qiū tiān dào le shù yè dōu huáng le
items.why: 都黄了 says the leaves have changed colour, which is a new state. 呢 would say they are yellow as things stand, without the change.
items.en: Autumn has come; the leaves have all turned yellow.

items.q: 我现在每天跑步，身体比以前好多___。
items.zh: 我现在每天跑步，身体比以前好多了。
items.py: wǒ xiàn zài měi tiān pǎo bù shēn tǐ bǐ yǐ qián hǎo duō le
items.why: 比以前好多了 compares the present with the past, a change, so 了 is needed. 吗 would ask and 的 would assure.
items.en: I run every day now, and I am much healthier than before.

items.q: 孩子的烧退了以后，就不再哭闹___，也肯吃东西了。
items.zh: 孩子的烧退了以后，就不再哭闹了，也肯吃东西了。
items.py: hái zi de shāo tuì le yǐ hòu jiù bú zài kū nào le yě kěn chī dōng xi le
items.why: 不再 + verb + 了 marks "no longer" after a change. 呢 would say he is still fussing, which clashes with 烧退了.
items.en: After the child's fever went down, he stopped crying and fussing and was willing to eat again.

items.q: 他以前很怕打针，现在长大了，一点儿也不怕___。
items.zh: 他以前很怕打针，现在长大了，一点儿也不怕了。
items.py: tā yǐ qián hěn pà dǎ zhēn xiàn zài zhǎng dà le yī diǎn r yě bú pà le
items.why: 以前...现在 sets up a change, so 不怕了 means "not any more". 呢 would stress that he is not afraid at the moment, with no sense of change.
items.en: He used to be very afraid of injections, but now he has grown up and is not afraid at all any more.

items.zh: 外面还下着雨呢。
items.py: wài miàn hái xià zhe yǔ ne
items.why: 着 and 还 show the rain is continuing, and 呢 closes the sentence. A final particle is always last.
items.en: It is still raining outside.

items.zh: 你最近睡得好吗？
items.py: nǐ zuì jìn shuì de hǎo ma
items.why: 吗 must come last to turn the statement into a yes/no question. 最近 can sit before or after 你.
items.en: Have you been sleeping well lately?

items.zh: 你先去医院检查一下吧。
items.py: nǐ xiān qù yī yuàn jiǎn chá yī xià ba
items.why: 先 goes before the verb phrase, and 吧 comes last to soften the advice.
items.en: Why don't you go to the hospital for a check-up first.

items.zh: 春天很暖和，夏天呢？
items.py: chūn tiān hěn nuǎn huo xià tiān ne
items.why: 夏天呢 is a noun plus 呢, asking the same question about another item. 呢 follows the noun directly.
items.en: Spring is warm. What about summer?

items.zh: 你昨天大概没睡好吧。
items.py: nǐ zuó tiān dà gài méi shuì hǎo ba
items.why: 吧 ends the sentence to seek confirmation of a guess. 大概 may stand before the subject or before the verb phrase.
items.en: You probably did not sleep well last night, I suppose.

items.task: Say you do not do it any more.
items.zh: 我不吃辣的了。
items.py: wǒ bù chī là de le
items.why: "Not any more" is 不 + verb + 了. Leaving out 了 would only say you do not eat it, with no change.
items.en: I do not eat spicy food any more.

items.src_py: nǐ jīn tiān qù yī yuàn
items.task: Turn it into a yes/no question.
items.zh: 你今天去医院吗？
items.py: nǐ jīn tiān qù yī yuàn ma
items.why: 吗 at the end turns a statement into a yes/no question. 今天 can come before or after the subject.
items.en: Are you going to the hospital today?

items.task: Say it is snowing right now, with 着 and 呢.
items.zh: 外面下着雪呢。
items.py: wài miàn xià zhe xuě ne
items.why: 着 gives the continuing state and 呢 stresses that it is going on now.
items.en: It is snowing outside.

items.task: Soften it into a gentle suggestion.
items.zh: 你多喝水吧。
items.py: nǐ duō hē shuǐ ba
items.why: Adding 吧 turns a flat command into friendly advice.
items.en: Drink more water.

items.src_py: zhè ge zhōu mò bú xià yǔ
items.task: Reassure someone: it definitely will not rain this weekend.
items.zh: 这个周末一定不会下雨的。
items.py: zhè ge zhōu mò yī dìng bú huì xià yǔ de
items.why: 一定不会...的 is the reassuring promise about the future. Ending in 了 would say something has changed, which is not the point.
items.en: It definitely will not rain this weekend.

items.s_py: nǐ jīn tiān nǎ r bù shū fu ma
items.zh: 你今天哪儿不舒服？
items.py: nǐ jīn tiān nǎ r bù shū fu
items.why: 哪儿 already makes this a question, so 吗 cannot be added.
items.en: Where do you feel unwell today?

items.s_py: nǐ chī yào hái shi dǎ zhēn ma
items.zh: 你吃药还是打针？
items.py: nǐ chī yào hái shi dǎ zhēn
items.why: 还是 asks for a choice, so the sentence is already a question and 吗 is wrong.
items.en: Will you take medicine or have an injection?

items.s: 你想吃点什么清淡的吗？
items.s_py: nǐ xiǎng chī diǎn shén me qīng dàn de ma
items.zh: 你想吃点什么清淡的吗？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng chī diǎn shén me qīng dàn de ma
items.why: Here 什么 means "something", not an information question, so the sentence is a yes/no question and 吗 is correct.
items.en: Would you like something light to eat?

items.s_py: wǒ gǎn mào le nǐ ma
items.zh: 我感冒了，你呢？
items.py: wǒ gǎn mào le nǐ ne
items.why: Bouncing the question back with a bare pronoun is 你呢; 吗 needs a full statement.
items.en: I have a cold. What about you?

items.s_py: nǐ míng tiān yǒu kòng ne
items.zh: 你明天有空吗？
items.py: nǐ míng tiān yǒu kòng ma
items.why: 呢 cannot turn a statement into a yes/no question; that is the job of 吗.
items.en: Are you free tomorrow?

items.s: 这么大的雪，我们怎么回家呢？
items.s_py: zhè me dà de xuě wǒ men zěn me huí jiā ne
items.zh: 这么大的雪，我们怎么回家呢？
items.py: zhè me dà de xuě wǒ men zěn me huí jiā ne
items.why: 怎么 already asks the question, and 呢 may be added to soften it. 吗 would be wrong here, but 呢 is correct.
items.en: With snow this heavy, how are we going to get home?

items.s: 雨还没停了，你再等一会儿。
items.s_py: yǔ hái méi tíng le nǐ zài děng yī huì r
items.zh: 雨还没停呢，你再等一会儿。
items.py: yǔ hái méi tíng ne nǐ zài děng yī huì r
items.why: 还没 never takes 了; 呢 expresses that the rain is still going on.
items.en: The rain has not stopped yet; wait a bit longer.

items.s: 他还没退烧呢，你怎么就让他去上学了？
items.s_py: tā hái méi tuì shāo ne nǐ zěn me jiù ràng tā qù shàng xué le
items.zh: 他还没退烧呢，你怎么就让他去上学了？
items.py: tā hái méi tuì shāo ne nǐ zěn me jiù ràng tā qù shàng xué le
items.why: The first clause uses 还没...呢, and the second clause ends in 了 because letting him go has already happened. Both particles are correct.
items.en: His fever has not gone down yet, so how could you let him go to school?

items.s: 好吧，我今天不去上班了，在家休息。
items.s_py: hǎo ba wǒ jīn tiān bú qù shàng bān le zài jiā xiū xi
items.zh: 好吧，我今天不去上班了，在家休息。
items.py: hǎo ba wǒ jīn tiān bú qù shàng bān le zài jiā xiū xi
items.why: 好吧 gives in, and 不...了 shows a change of plan. Both particles are correct.
items.en: All right then, I will not go to work today; I will rest at home.

items.s_py: nǐ zuó wǎn méi shuì hǎo ba ma
items.zh: 你昨晚没睡好吧？
items.py: nǐ zuó wǎn méi shuì hǎo ba
items.why: 吧 and 吗 are never used together. A guess takes 吧 alone.
items.en: You did not sleep well last night, did you?

items.s: 他应该已经吃过药了吧？
items.s_py: tā yīng gāi yǐ jīng chī guo yào le ba
items.zh: 他应该已经吃过药了吧？
items.py: tā yīng gāi yǐ jīng chī guo yào le ba
items.why: 应该 shows the guess, so 吧 is right even after 了. A sentence-final 了 and 吧 can sit together.
items.en: He should have taken his medicine already, right?

items.s_py: jīn tiān de tiān qì zhēn hǎo ma
items.zh: 今天的天气真好啊！
items.py: jīn tiān de tiān qì zhēn hǎo a
items.why: An exclamation with 真 takes 啊. 吗 would turn it into a question, which clashes with the exclamation mark.
items.en: The weather is so nice today!

items.s: 你快去看医生啊，别再拖了！
items.s_py: nǐ kuài qù kàn yī shēng a bié zài tuō le
items.zh: 你快去看医生啊，别再拖了！
items.py: nǐ kuài qù kàn yī shēng a bié zài tuō le
items.why: 啊 warms a friendly urging and does not change the sentence type. The sentence-final 了 after 别再拖 is also correct.
items.en: Hurry and see a doctor; stop putting it off!

items.s: 我早就说你应该去医院吗，你怎么不听呢？
items.s_py: wǒ zǎo jiù shuō nǐ yīng gāi qù yī yuàn ma nǐ zěn me bù tīng ne
items.zh: 我早就说你应该去医院嘛，你怎么不听呢？
items.py: wǒ zǎo jiù shuō nǐ yīng gāi qù yī yuàn ma nǐ zěn me bù tīng ne
items.why: The speaker is pointing out something obvious, which is 嘛. 吗 would ask a question, which clashes with the reproach.
items.en: I told you long ago that you should go to the hospital; why will you not listen?

items.s_py: gǎn mào le jiù duō hē shuǐ bei
items.zh: 感冒了就多喝水呗。
items.py: gǎn mào le jiù duō hē shuǐ bei
items.why: 就...呗 says the fix is simple. It is informal but fully correct.
items.en: If you have a cold, just drink more water.

items.s: 别担心，明天一定会晴了。
items.s_py: bié dān xīn míng tiān yī dìng huì qíng le
items.zh: 别担心，明天一定会晴的。
items.py: bié dān xīn míng tiān yī dìng huì qíng de
items.why: Reassurance about the future is 会...的. 了 reports a change that has happened, so it cannot follow 一定会.
items.en: Do not worry, tomorrow will definitely be sunny.

items.s_py: wǒ yǐ jīng bù fā shāo
items.zh: 我已经不发烧了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng bù fā shāo le
items.why: "Not any more" needs 了 at the end: 不 + verb + 了. Without it the sentence is incomplete.
items.en: I do not have a fever any more.

items.s: 她现在是一名护士了，以前在药店工作。
items.s_py: tā xiàn zài shì yī míng hù shi le yǐ qián zài yào diàn gōng zuò
items.zh: 她现在是一名护士了，以前在药店工作。
items.py: tā xiàn zài shì yī míng hù shi le yǐ qián zài yào diàn gōng zuò
items.why: 现在 + 是 + noun + 了 marks a new status, and 了 is natural with 是. This is correct.
items.en: She is a nurse now; she used to work in a pharmacy.

items.s_py: wǒ xǐ huān yóu yǒng nǐ ma
items.zh: 我喜欢游泳，你呢？
items.py: wǒ xǐ huān yóu yǒng nǐ ne
items.en: I like swimming. And you?
items.why: 'And you?' bouncing the question back is pronoun + 呢. 吗 needs a full statement before it, not a bare 你.

items.s: 放心，我们这次一定会赢的。
items.s_py: fàng xīn wǒ men zhè cì yī dìng huì yíng de
items.zh: 放心，我们这次一定会赢的。
items.py: fàng xīn wǒ men zhè cì yī dìng huì yíng de
items.en: Don't worry, we will definitely win this time.
items.why: 会...的 is the standard assurance about the future. It looks like it needs 了 after 赢, but 的 is correct here.

items.s_py: jīn tiān de bǐ sài zhēn hǎo kàn ma
items.zh: 今天的比赛真好看啊！
items.py: jīn tiān de bǐ sài zhēn hǎo kàn a
items.en: What a great match today!
items.why: 真好看 is an exclamation, and 吗 would make it a yes/no question. The warm particle is 啊.

items.q: 别关灯，球场上还有人在练球___。
items.zh: 别关灯，球场上还有人在练球呢。
items.py: bié guān dēng qiú chǎng shàng hái yǒu rén zài liàn qiú ne
items.en: Don't turn off the lights; there are still people practising on the pitch.
items.why: 还 + 在 + verb shows an ongoing state, and 呢 points it out to a listener who may not realise. 吗 would ask instead of inform.

items.q: 请问，地铁站在哪儿___？
items.zh: 请问，地铁站在哪儿？
items.py: qǐng wèn dì tiě zhàn zài nǎ r
items.en: Excuse me, where is the subway station?
items.why: 哪儿 already makes this a question, so 吗 must not be added. 吗 only turns a statement into a yes/no question.

items.q: 这么大的雨，比赛应该会推迟___。
items.zh: 这么大的雨，比赛应该会推迟吧。
items.py: zhè me dà de yǔ bǐ sài yīng gāi huì tuī chí ba
items.en: With rain this heavy, the match will probably be postponed, I suppose.
items.why: 应该 expresses a presumption, and 吧 marks it as a guess open to confirmation. 嘛 would claim it is obvious, and 吗 would ask a question.

items.q: 你放心，他会来___。
items.zh: 你放心，他会来的。
items.py: nǐ fàng xīn tā huì lái de
items.en: Don't worry, he will come.
items.why: 会...的 is a promise about the future after 放心. 了 would say he has now started coming, which does not reassure.

items.q: 你大概是第一次来这个球场___？
items.zh: 你大概是第一次来这个球场吧？
items.py: nǐ dà gài shì dì yī cì lái zhè ge qiú chǎng ba
items.en: I'd guess this is your first time at this pitch, right?
items.why: 大概 marks a guess that invites confirmation, so 吧. 吗 would ask a neutral question and sounds odd after 大概.

items.s: 现在才九点，商店还没开门呢。
items.s_py: xiàn zài cái jiǔ diǎn shāng diàn hái méi kāi mén ne
items.zh: 现在才九点，商店还没开门呢。
items.py: xiàn zài cái jiǔ diǎn shāng diàn hái méi kāi mén ne
items.en: It's only nine o'clock; the shops haven't opened yet.
items.why: 才 and 还没 both describe a situation that has not changed, so 呢 is right. It looks odd without 了, but 还没 never takes 了.

items.q: 路灯都亮___，我们该回家了。
items.zh: 路灯都亮了，我们该回家了。
items.py: lù dēng dōu liàng le wǒ men gāi huí jiā le
items.en: The street lamps have all come on; we should go home.
items.why: 亮了 reports that the lights have just come on, a change. 吗 would ask a question and 的 would be an assurance.

items.q: 你别催，我正在查去机场的路线___，马上就好。
items.zh: 你别催，我正在查去机场的路线呢，马上就好。
items.py: nǐ bié cuī wǒ zhèng zài chá qù jī chǎng de lù xiàn ne mǎ shàng jiù hǎo
items.en: Stop rushing me; I'm checking the route to the airport and it'll be done in a moment.
items.why: 正在 + verb is a progressive action, and 呢 tells the listener it is going on right now. 吗 would turn the sentence into a question.

items.zh: 这座城市的夜景多漂亮啊！
items.py: zhè zuò chéng shì de yè jǐng duō piào liàng a
items.en: How beautiful the night view of this city is!
items.why: 多 + adjective + 啊 is an exclamation, so 多 comes before 漂亮 and 啊 closes the sentence.

items.q: 请问，去博物馆要换几次车___？
items.zh: 请问，去博物馆要换几次车？
items.py: qǐng wèn qù bó wù guǎn yào huàn jǐ cì chē
items.en: Excuse me, how many times do I change to get to the museum?
items.why: 几次 is a question word asking for a number, so the sentence is already a question and 吗 is wrong.

items.q: 他的网球打得这么好，以前一定学过___？
items.zh: 他的网球打得这么好，以前一定学过吧？
items.py: tā de wǎng qiú dǎ de zhè me hǎo yǐ qián yī dìng xué guò ba
items.en: He plays tennis so well; he must have learned before, right?
items.why: 一定 plus a conclusion from evidence calls for 吧, seeking agreement. 吗 would not fit a speaker who is already convinced.

items.s_py: tā shàng gè yuè méi lái le
items.zh: 他上个月没来。
items.py: tā shàng gè yuè méi lái
items.en: He didn't come last month.
items.why: 没 already says it did not happen in the past, so 了 cannot be added. A plain past negative takes only 没.

items.s_py: nǐ bù xiǎng qù jiù bié qù bei
items.zh: 你不想去就别去呗。
items.py: nǐ bù xiǎng qù jiù bié qù bei
items.en: If you don't want to go, then don't.
items.why: ...就...呗 is a casual 'then just don't' shrug. It looks like it lacks a verb after 就, but 别去 is the verb.

items.s_py: tā wèi shén me méi lái bǐ sài ne
items.zh: 他为什么没来比赛呢？
items.py: tā wèi shén me méi lái bǐ sài ne
items.en: Why didn't he come to the match, I wonder?
items.why: 呢 can soften a question that already has a question word. It is optional but correct, while 吗 would be wrong here.

items.q: 地铁快进站___，请站在黄线后面。
items.zh: 地铁快进站了，请站在黄线后面。
items.py: dì tiě kuài jìn zhàn le qǐng zhàn zài huáng xiàn hòu miàn
items.en: The train is about to arrive; please stand behind the yellow line.
items.why: 快...了 says something is about to happen, a new situation. 吗 would ask, and 吧 would soften it into a guess.

items.task: Turn it into a yes/no question with 吗.
items.zh: 你想去公园吗？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng qù gōng yuán ma
items.en: Do you want to go to the park?
items.why: 吗 goes at the very end of the statement; nothing else moves.

items.s: 路太远了，我们打车去吧吗。
items.s_py: lù tài yuǎn le wǒ men dǎ chē qù ba ma
items.zh: 路太远了，我们打车去吧。
items.py: lù tài yuǎn le wǒ men dǎ chē qù ba
items.en: The way is too far; let's take a taxi.
items.why: 吧 and 吗 never combine. A suggestion takes 吧 alone.

items.s_py: bǐ sài hái méi kāi shǐ le
items.zh: 比赛还没开始呢。
items.py: bǐ sài hái méi kāi shǐ ne
items.en: The match hasn't started yet.
items.why: 还没 describes an unchanged situation, so 了 is impossible. The right particle is 呢.

items.q: 他们为什么不来参加这次马拉松比赛___？
items.zh: 他们为什么不来参加这次马拉松比赛？
items.py: tā men wèi shén me bù lái cān jiā zhè cì mǎ lā sōng bǐ sài
items.en: Why aren't they coming to this marathon?
items.why: 为什么 asks for a reason, so the sentence is already a question. Adding 吗 gives a wh-word plus a yes/no marker, which is wrong.

items.s_py: nǐ zuò dì tiě hái shì qí chē ma
items.zh: 你坐地铁还是骑车？
items.py: nǐ zuò dì tiě hái shì qí chē
items.en: Are you taking the subway or riding a bike?
items.why: 还是 already asks the listener to choose, so the sentence is a question and 吗 cannot be added.

items.q: 请问，这条路可以骑自行车___？
items.zh: 请问，这条路可以骑自行车吗？
items.py: qǐng wèn zhè tiáo lù kě yǐ qí zì xíng chē ma
items.en: Excuse me, can you ride a bike on this road?
items.why: 请问 shows a stranger asking for plain information with no guess behind it, so 吗. 吧 would mean 'I suppose you can, right?', and 呢 cannot make a statement a question.

items.s_py: nǐ xiǎng chī diǎn shén me ma
items.zh: 你想吃点什么吗？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng chī diǎn shén me ma
items.en: Would you like something to eat?
items.why: Here 什么 means 'something', not 'what', so the sentence is a yes/no question and 吗 is correct. It looks wrong because of 什么.

items.q: 我现在不想去爬山___。
items.zh: 我现在不想去爬山了。
items.py: wǒ xiàn zài bù xiǎng qù pá shān le
items.en: I don't want to go hiking any more.
items.why: 不 + verb + 了 means 'not any more', a change from before. 呢 would say the opposite, that I still do not want to.

items.q: 下雨___，今天不踢球了。
items.zh: 下雨了，今天不踢球了。
items.py: xià yǔ le jīn tiān bù tī qiú le
items.en: It's started raining, so no football today.
items.why: 下雨了 reports a new situation: it was dry before and is raining now. 吗 would ask a question and 的 would promise future rain.

items.q: 外面下着大雨___，别去跑步了。
items.zh: 外面下着大雨呢，别去跑步了。
items.py: wài miàn xià zhe dà yǔ ne bié qù pǎo bù le
items.en: It's pouring outside; don't go running.
items.why: 着 describes a state that is still going on, and 呢 stresses that it is the case right now. 吗 would turn the warning into a question.

items.q: 他现在当上足球队的队长___。
items.zh: 他现在当上足球队的队长了。
items.py: tā xiàn zài dāng shàng zú qiú duì de duì zhǎng le
items.en: He has become the football team's captain now.
items.why: 当上 + 现在 reports a new status, and 了 marks it as new. 呢 would say he is still in the process of something.

items.s: 这条街以前很安静，现在热闹了。
items.s_py: zhè tiáo jiē yǐ qián hěn ān jìng xiàn zài rè nào le
items.zh: 这条街以前很安静，现在热闹了。
items.py: zhè tiáo jiē yǐ qián hěn ān jìng xiàn zài rè nào le
items.en: This street used to be quiet, but now it's lively.
items.why: 现在 + adjective + 了 reports a change from 以前. It looks like the adjective should take 很, but 了 already marks the new state.

items.q: 别灰心，这次输了，下次你们一定会赢___。
items.zh: 别灰心，这次输了，下次你们一定会赢的。
items.py: bié huī xīn zhè cì shū le xià cì nǐ men yī dìng huì yíng de
items.en: Don't lose heart; you lost this time, but you will definitely win next time.
items.why: 一定会...的 comforts the listener with certainty about the future. 吧 would make it a guess and 了 would report a change.

items.q: 来，我们一起打羽毛球___。
items.zh: 来，我们一起打羽毛球吧。
items.py: lái wǒ men yì qǐ dǎ yǔ máo qiú ba
items.en: Come on, let's play badminton together.
items.why: 来 plus 我们一起 is an invitation, and 吧 makes it a suggestion. 吗 would turn it into a question and 了 is wrong for an invitation.

items.q: 别担心，明天不会下雨___。
items.zh: 别担心，明天不会下雨的。
items.py: bié dān xīn míng tiān bú huì xià yǔ de
items.en: Don't worry, it won't rain tomorrow.
items.why: 不会...的 is a calm reassurance about the future. 了 reports a change that has happened, 吗 would ask a question, and 呢 would say 'still going on' instead of reassuring.

items.zh: 他在操场打篮球呢。
items.py: tā zài cāo chǎng dǎ lán qiú ne
items.en: He's playing basketball on the sports ground right now.
items.why: 在操场 only gives the place; the final 呢 is what says it is happening right now. 呢 closes the sentence and cannot go earlier.

items.q: 别进去，他们在打球___。
items.zh: 别进去，他们在打球呢。
items.py: bié jìn qù tā men zài dǎ qiú ne
items.en: Don't go in; they're playing ball.
items.why: 在 + verb marks an action in progress, and the sentence-final 呢 says 'it is happening right now'. 吗 would turn it into a question.

items.s: 他还是个孩子嘛，别骂他。
items.s_py: tā hái shì gè hái zi ma bié mà tā
items.zh: 他还是个孩子嘛，别骂他。
items.py: tā hái shì gè hái zi ma bié mà tā
items.en: He's still a child, after all; don't scold him.
items.why: 嘛 says the reason is obvious and never asks. It sounds like 吗 but here it is the right particle.

items.q: 我们怎么去体育馆___？
items.zh: 我们怎么去体育馆呢？
items.py: wǒ men zěn me qù tǐ yù guǎn ne
items.en: So how are we getting to the gym?
items.why: 怎么 makes this a question, so 吗 is impossible. 呢 is the particle that softens a question-word question and sounds like 'so, how?'.

items.q: 我喜欢跑步，你___？
items.zh: 我喜欢跑步，你呢？
items.py: wǒ xǐ huān pǎo bù nǐ ne
items.en: I like running. And you?
items.why: Bouncing the same question back after a statement is pronoun + 呢. 吗 needs a full statement before it, not a bare 你.

items.s_py: bié dān xīn tā yī dìng huì lái le
items.zh: 别担心，他一定会来的。
items.py: bié dān xīn tā yī dìng huì lái de
items.en: Don't worry, he'll definitely come.
items.why: Reassurance about the future is 会...的. 了 reports a change that has happened and does not fit 一定会.

items.q: 你踢得真好___！
items.zh: 你踢得真好啊！
items.py: nǐ tī de zhēn hǎo a
items.en: You play so well!
items.why: An admiring exclamation with 真 takes 啊. 吗 would ask a question, and the warm praise would be lost.

items.q: 只要多练习，你一定会进步___。
items.zh: 只要多练习，你一定会进步的。
items.py: zhǐ yào duō liàn xí nǐ yī dìng huì jìn bù de
items.en: As long as you practise more, you will certainly improve.
items.why: 一定会...的 gives a confident assurance. 吗 would turn the promise into a question and 呢 does not mean 'for sure'.

items.src_py: wǒ men méi dào tǐ yù guǎn
items.task: Say it has not happened yet, with 还没.
items.zh: 我们还没到体育馆呢。
items.py: wǒ men hái méi dào tǐ yù guǎn ne
items.en: We haven't got to the gym yet.
items.why: 还没 means 'not yet' and takes 呢, never 了, at the end.

items.s_py: wǒ cái bù qù pǎo bù ma
items.zh: 我才不去跑步呢！
items.py: wǒ cái bù qù pǎo bù ne
items.en: I'm certainly not going running!
items.why: 才不 + verb + 呢 is a forceful refusal. 吗 would make a question, which clashes with the exclamation.

items.q: 时间不早了，我们回家___。
items.zh: 时间不早了，我们回家吧。
items.py: shí jiān bù zǎo le wǒ men huí jiā ba
items.en: It's getting late; let's go home.
items.why: 'Let's...' is a suggestion, which is 吧. 吗 would ask whether we are going home rather than propose it.

items.q: 今天我没空，明天___？
items.zh: 今天我没空，明天呢？
items.py: jīn tiān wǒ méi kòng míng tiān ne
items.en: I'm busy today. How about tomorrow?
items.why: 'What about X?' after a previous statement is noun + 呢. 吗 would need a complete clause such as 明天你有空吗.

items.q: 我本来想睡懒觉，不过好___，周六早上八点体育馆门口见。
items.zh: 我本来想睡懒觉，不过好吧，周六早上八点体育馆门口见。
items.py: wǒ běn lái xiǎng shuì lǎn jiào bú guò hǎo ba zhōu liù zǎo shang bā diǎn tǐ yù guǎn mén kǒu jiàn
items.en: I wanted to sleep in, but all right then; see you at the gym entrance at eight on Saturday.
items.why: 好吧 means 'all right then', giving in reluctantly. 好吗 would ask whether it is fine, and 好呢 means nothing here.

items.q: 骑车穿过老城区，那种感觉多自由___！
items.zh: 骑车穿过老城区，那种感觉多自由啊！
items.py: qí chē chuān guò lǎo chéng qū nà zhǒng gǎn jué duō zì yóu a
items.en: Cycling through the old town, what a free feeling!
items.why: 多 + adjective is an exclamation, so 啊. 吗 would turn the feeling into a question and 的 is not an exclamation particle.

items.q: 不会游泳就去学___，现在开始也不晚。
items.zh: 不会游泳就去学呗，现在开始也不晚。
items.py: bú huì yóu yǒng jiù qù xué bei xiàn zài kāi shǐ yě bù wǎn
items.en: If you can't swim, then go and learn; it's not too late to start now.
items.why: 不会...就学 + 呗 treats the fix as the obvious thing to do. 吗 would ask, and 的 gives a promise rather than advice.

items.q: 你应该是新来的教练___？
items.zh: 你应该是新来的教练吧？
items.py: nǐ yīng gāi shì xīn lái de jiào liàn ba
items.en: You must be the new coach, right?
items.why: 应该 shows the speaker is guessing and wants confirmation, which is 吧. 吗 would be a neutral question with no guess.

items.q: 我还没找到那个体育馆___。
items.zh: 我还没找到那个体育馆呢。
items.py: wǒ hái méi zhǎo dào nà ge tǐ yù guǎn ne
items.en: I still haven't found that gym.
items.why: 还没 describes a situation that has not changed, which is 呢. 了 signals a new situation and cannot follow 没.

items.q: 你喜欢打篮球___？
items.zh: 你喜欢打篮球吗？
items.py: nǐ xǐ huān dǎ lán qiú ma
items.en: Do you like playing basketball?
items.why: A plain statement becomes a neutral yes/no question with 吗. 呢 needs a noun or an existing question word, and 吧 would mean the speaker already guesses yes.

items.zh: 你放心，他一定会来的。
items.py: nǐ fàng xīn tā yī dìng huì lái de
items.en: Don't worry, he'll definitely come.
items.why: 一定会...的 frames the assurance: 的 stays at the very end, with 会 before the verb. 你放心 may open or close the sentence.

items.q: 没有球拍就借___，别不好意思。
items.zh: 没有球拍就借呗，别不好意思。
items.py: méi yǒu qiú pāi jiù jiè bei bié bù hǎo yì sī
items.en: If you don't have a racket, just borrow one; don't be shy.
items.why: 没有...就借 + 呗 says the solution is simple. 吗 would ask a question, and 了 would claim the borrowing is done.

items.s_py: nǐ zuó tiān qù kàn qiú sài le ba
items.zh: 你昨天去看球赛了吧？
items.py: nǐ zuó tiān qù kàn qiú sài le ba
items.en: You went to watch the match yesterday, didn't you?
items.why: 吧 on a statement is a presumption seeking agreement, and 了 here is the normal verb-了. It looks like a double particle but is fine.

items.q: 比赛输了也没关系，下次再来___。
items.zh: 比赛输了也没关系，下次再来呗。
items.py: bǐ sài shū le yě méi guān xì xià cì zài lái bei
items.en: Losing the match doesn't matter; just come back next time.
items.why: 下次再来呗 says 'so what, just try again', a shrug. 吗 would ask whether we come back, and 的 would promise it.

items.q: 你想去就去___，不用问我。
items.zh: 你想去就去呗，不用问我。
items.py: nǐ xiǎng qù jiù qù bei bù yòng wèn wǒ
items.en: If you want to go, just go; no need to ask me.
items.why: ...就...呗 means 'then just do it', shrugging off the need to ask. 吗 would turn the sentence into a question.

items.q: 我想问一下，你去过那家羽毛球馆___？
items.zh: 我想问一下，你去过那家羽毛球馆吗？
items.py: wǒ xiǎng wèn yī xià nǐ qù guò nà jiā yǔ máo qiú guǎn ma
items.en: I'd like to ask: have you ever been to that badminton hall?
items.why: 我想问一下 shows the speaker has no idea and asks for plain information, so 吗. 吧 would suggest the speaker expects yes, and 呢 cannot turn a statement into a question.

items.q: 队员们还没来齐___，再等几分钟吧。
items.zh: 队员们还没来齐呢，再等几分钟吧。
items.py: duì yuán men hái méi lái qí ne zài děng jǐ fēn zhōng ba
items.en: The players haven't all arrived yet; let's wait a few more minutes.
items.why: 还没 means nothing has changed yet, so 了 is impossible. 呢 marks 'still the case'.

items.src_py: wǒ zài dì tiě zhàn nǐ zài nǎ r
items.task: Shorten the second part to 'And you?'
items.zh: 我在地铁站，你呢？
items.py: wǒ zài dì tiě zhàn nǐ ne
items.en: I'm at the subway station. And you?
items.why: Pronoun + 呢 bounces the same question back without repeating it.

items.q: 咱们是坐地铁去还是骑共享单车去___？
items.zh: 咱们是坐地铁去还是骑共享单车去呢？
items.py: zán men shì zuò dì tiě qù hái shì qí gòng xiǎng dān chē qù ne
items.en: So are we going by subway or on shared bikes?
items.why: 还是 already offers the choice, so 吗 is out. 呢 can sit at the end of such a question to make it sound like thinking aloud.

items.s_py: nǐ shì jiào liàn ba ma
items.zh: 你是教练吧？
items.py: nǐ shì jiào liàn ba
items.en: You're the coach, right?
items.why: 吧 and 吗 do not stack. 吧 alone says 'I guess you are, right?'.

items.q: 你要是累了，就别踢了，回家休息___。
items.zh: 你要是累了，就别踢了，回家休息吧。
items.py: nǐ yào shì lèi le jiù bié tī le huí jiā xiū xi ba
items.en: If you're tired, stop playing and go home to rest.
items.why: The last clause is gentle advice, which is 吧. 吗 would make the advice a question.

items.q: 我跑累___，想坐一会儿。
items.zh: 我跑累了，想坐一会儿。
items.py: wǒ pǎo lèi le xiǎng zuò yī huì r
items.en: I'm tired from running now; I want to sit for a bit.
items.why: 累了 says the speaker has now become tired, which is a change of state. 吗 would ask a question, and 呢 would say it is still going on.

items.q: 你的脚受伤了，当然不能跑___！
items.zh: 你的脚受伤了，当然不能跑嘛！
items.py: nǐ de jiǎo shòu shāng le dàng rán bù néng pǎo ma
items.en: Your foot is hurt, so of course you can't run!
items.why: 当然 means 'obviously', which is the job of 嘛. 吗 would turn the statement into a question, which contradicts the exclamation mark.

items.q: 这个公园真大___！
items.zh: 这个公园真大啊！
items.py: zhè ge gōng yuán zhēn dà a
items.en: This park is so big!
items.why: 真 + adjective is an exclamation, and 啊 adds warmth. 吗 would turn it into a question, which clashes with the exclamation mark.

items.src_py: wǒ men qù dǎ yǔ máo qiú
items.task: Make it a suggestion ('Let's...').
items.zh: 我们去打羽毛球吧。
items.py: wǒ men qù dǎ yǔ máo qiú ba
items.en: Let's go and play badminton.
items.why: 吧 at the end turns the plan into a suggestion.

items.q: 周末的地铁站人真多___！
items.zh: 周末的地铁站人真多啊！
items.py: zhōu mò de dì tiě zhàn rén zhēn duō a
items.en: The subway station is so crowded at weekends!
items.why: 真多 is an exclamation of surprise, and 啊 carries the feeling. 吗 would ask whether it is crowded.

items.s_py: wǒ bù xiǎng tī qiú le tài lèi le
items.zh: 我不想踢球了，太累了。
items.py: wǒ bù xiǎng tī qiú le tài lèi le
items.en: I don't want to play football any more; I'm too tired.
items.why: 不...了 means 'not any more'. The second 了 in 太累了 is the usual pattern, so both are correct.

items.q: 你昨天一定看了那场比赛___？
items.zh: 你昨天一定看了那场比赛吧？
items.py: nǐ zuó tiān yī dìng kàn le nà chǎng bǐ sài ba
items.en: You must have watched that match yesterday, right?
items.why: 一定 shows the speaker is sure and just wants agreement, which is 吧. 吗 would suggest the speaker does not know.

items.q: 我们才跑了两公里___，还能再跑一会儿。
items.zh: 我们才跑了两公里呢，还能再跑一会儿。
items.py: wǒ men cái pǎo le liǎng gōng lǐ ne hái néng zài pǎo yī huì r
items.en: We've only run two kilometres; we can run a bit more.
items.why: 才 marks a small amount and 呢 stresses that we are still far from tired or done. 了 or 吗 would not carry that 'only' tone.

items.q: 地图上说这条街还在修路___，我们得绕过去。
items.zh: 地图上说这条街还在修路呢，我们得绕过去。
items.py: dì tú shàng shuō zhè tiáo jiē hái zài xiū lù ne wǒ men děi rào guò qù
items.en: The map says this street is still being repaired, so we have to go around.
items.why: 还在 + verb says the roadwork has not finished, which 呢 expresses. 了 would announce a change, the opposite of 还.

items.q: 地铁站离这儿很远，我们还是打车去___。
items.zh: 地铁站离这儿很远，我们还是打车去吧。
items.py: dì tiě zhàn lí zhè r hěn yuǎn wǒ men hái shì dǎ chē qù ba
items.en: The subway station is far from here; we'd better take a taxi.
items.why: 还是 + action + 吧 gives a gentle recommendation after weighing options. 吗 would ask whether we take a taxi, and 呢 does not suggest.

items.s: 好吧，我跟你一起去看比赛。
items.s_py: hǎo ba wǒ gēn nǐ yì qǐ qù kàn bǐ sài
items.zh: 好吧，我跟你一起去看比赛。
items.py: hǎo ba wǒ gēn nǐ yì qǐ qù kàn bǐ sài
items.en: All right then, I'll go with you to watch the match.
items.why: 好吧 means 'all right then', giving in. It looks like 好 + 吧 as a question but is a fixed response.

items.q: 你是坐地铁去还是打车去___？
items.zh: 你是坐地铁去还是打车去？
items.py: nǐ shì zuò dì tiě qù hái shì dǎ chē qù
items.en: Are you going by subway or taking a taxi?
items.why: 还是 asks the listener to choose between two options, so the sentence is already a question and takes no 吗.

items.q: 天气很好，我们去公园跑步___。
items.zh: 天气很好，我们去公园跑步吧。
items.py: tiān qì hěn hǎo wǒ men qù gōng yuán pǎo bù ba
items.en: The weather is nice; let's go running in the park.
items.why: A proposal for both speakers to do something takes 吧. 吗 would only ask a question and 呢 does not suggest anything.

items.q: 这家店的人太多了，我们去对面那家___。
items.zh: 这家店的人太多了，我们去对面那家吧。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn de rén tài duō le wǒ men qù duì miàn nà jiā ba
items.en: This place is too crowded; let's go to the one across the street.
items.why: The speaker proposes an alternative, so 吧. 吗 would ask which shop we go to, and 的 does not fit a proposal.

items.task: Say it is no longer true.
items.zh: 我不喜欢跑步了。
items.py: wǒ bù xǐ huān pǎo bù le
items.en: I don't like running any more.
items.why: 不 + verb + 了 means 'not any more', a change from before. Without 了 it is just 'I don't like running'.

items.q: 我还没到十字路口___，你先别挂电话。
items.zh: 我还没到十字路口呢，你先别挂电话。
items.py: wǒ hái méi dào shí zì lù kǒu ne nǐ xiān bié guà diàn huà
items.en: I haven't reached the crossroads yet; don't hang up.
items.why: 还没 + 呢 says the situation is unchanged. 了 contradicts 没, and 吗 would ask whether I have arrived.

items.q: 既然大家都想去爬山，那就这个周末出发___。
items.zh: 既然大家都想去爬山，那就这个周末出发吧。
items.py: jì rán dà jiā dōu xiǎng qù pá shān nà jiù zhè ge zhōu mò chū fā ba
items.en: Since everyone wants to go hiking, let's set off this weekend.
items.why: The speaker settles the group's plan as a proposal, which is 吧. 吗 would reopen the question and 的 is not used for plans.

items.q: 山顶的夜景多美___！
items.zh: 山顶的夜景多美啊！
items.py: shān dǐng de yè jǐng duō měi a
items.en: How beautiful the night view from the mountaintop is!
items.why: 多 + adjective + 啊 is the standard exclamation. 吗 would ask about the view, and 了 would claim the view has changed.

items.q: 自从搬到市中心以后，我就不开车上班___。
items.zh: 自从搬到市中心以后，我就不开车上班了。
items.py: zì cóng bān dào shì zhōng xīn yǐ hòu wǒ jiù bù kāi chē shàng bān le
items.en: Since moving downtown I don't drive to work any more.
items.why: 自从...以后 contrasts now with before, so 不...了 'not any more'. 的 would turn it into a promise and 吗 would ask a question.

items.q: 这条街现在不通车___，你得走路过去。
items.zh: 这条街现在不通车了，你得走路过去。
items.py: zhè tiáo jiē xiàn zài bù tōng chē le nǐ děi zǒu lù guò qù
items.en: This street is closed to traffic now, so you'll have to walk over.
items.why: 现在 + 不 + verb + 了 marks a change from open to closed. 吗 would ask a question, and 的 would be an assurance about the future.

items.q: 你先坐下来休息一下___。
items.zh: 你先坐下来休息一下吧。
items.py: nǐ xiān zuò xià lái xiū xi yī xià ba
items.en: Why don't you sit down and rest a bit first?
items.why: 吧 softens an instruction into a friendly suggestion. 吗 would ask whether you are resting, and 的 does not fit a command.

items.q: 如果周末不下雨，你愿意跟我们一起去骑车___？
items.zh: 如果周末不下雨，你愿意跟我们一起去骑车吗？
items.py: rú guǒ zhōu mò bù xià yǔ nǐ yuàn yì gēn wǒ men yì qǐ qù qí chē ma
items.en: If it doesn't rain at the weekend, would you like to go cycling with us?
items.why: This is an open invitation-question asking whether the listener is willing, so 吗. 嘛 states the obvious and never asks, and 吧 would turn it into a guess.

items.q: 他大概不会来___。
items.zh: 他大概不会来吧。
items.py: tā dà gài bú huì lái ba
items.en: He probably won't come, I suppose.
items.why: 大概 marks a guess, and 吧 softens the statement as 'I suppose'. 吗 would ask a neutral question that conflicts with 大概.

items.s_py: nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ r ma
items.zh: 你想去哪儿？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ r
items.en: Where do you want to go?
items.why: 哪儿 already makes this a question, so 吗 cannot be added. Only a statement can take 吗.

items.q: 我早就说过这条路不近___。
items.zh: 我早就说过这条路不近嘛。
items.py: wǒ zǎo jiù shuō guò zhè tiáo lù bù jìn ma
items.en: I told you long ago this road isn't short.
items.why: 嘛 reminds the listener of something already said, with 'I told you so'. 吗 would ask whether I said it.

items.q: 你周末去不去踢足球___？
items.zh: 你周末去不去踢足球？
items.py: nǐ zhōu mò qù bù qù tī zú qiú
items.en: Are you going to play football at the weekend or not?
items.why: 去不去 is the question, so 吗 would double it. Use verb-不-verb or 吗, never both.

items.q: 对不起，这附近有银行___？
items.zh: 对不起，这附近有银行吗？
items.py: duì bu qǐ zhè fù jìn yǒu yín háng ma
items.en: Excuse me, is there a bank near here?
items.why: Asking a stranger about something you know nothing of is a neutral yes/no question, so 吗. 吧 would mean you already guess there is one, and 呢 would only fit with a noun alone, as in 银行呢?

items.q: 我的球拍___？
items.zh: 我的球拍呢？
items.py: wǒ de qiú pāi ne
items.en: Where's my racket?
items.why: A bare noun + 呢 asks where it is. 吗 cannot follow a bare noun, and 了 would not ask anything.

items.q: 现在才五点___，不用急。
items.zh: 现在才五点呢，不用急。
items.py: xiàn zài cái wǔ diǎn ne bù yòng jí
items.en: It's only five o'clock now; no need to hurry.
items.why: 才 + time + 呢 stresses 'only' and that things are still early. 了 would say it has become five, which contradicts 才.

items.q: 我答应你，今年夏天一定会教你游泳___。
items.zh: 我答应你，今年夏天一定会教你游泳的。
items.py: wǒ dā yìng nǐ jīn nián xià tiān yī dìng huì jiào nǐ yóu yǒng de
items.en: I promise you, I will definitely teach you to swim this summer.
items.why: 答应 plus 一定会...的 is a solemn promise. 吧 would turn it into a weak guess and 吗 would ask whether I will.

items.q: 他是新手___，打不好很正常。
items.zh: 他是新手嘛，打不好很正常。
items.py: tā shì xīn shǒu ma dǎ bù hǎo hěn zhèng cháng
items.en: He's a beginner, after all; it's normal for him not to play well.
items.why: 嘛 says 'after all', giving the obvious reason. 吗 would ask 'Is he a beginner?' and does not fit before a continuing comment.

items.zh: 外面的路灯都亮了。
items.py: wài miàn de lù dēng dōu liàng le
items.en: The street lamps outside have all come on.
items.why: 了 closes the sentence to mark the change, and 都 goes before the verb 亮.

items.q: 他为什么今天没来踢球___？
items.zh: 他为什么今天没来踢球呢？
items.py: tā wèi shén me jīn tiān méi lái tī qiú ne
items.en: Why didn't he come to play football today, I wonder?
items.why: 为什么 already asks the question, and 呢 only softens it. 吗 can never follow a question word, and 吧 would turn it into a guess.

items.q: 这么晚了，商店应该都关门了___？
items.zh: 这么晚了，商店应该都关门了吧？
items.py: zhè me wǎn le shāng diàn yīng gāi dōu guān mén le ba
items.en: It's so late; the shops must all be closed, I take it?
items.why: 应该 shows an assumption the speaker wants confirmed, so 吧. 吗 does not combine with 应该, because it signals no opinion at all.

items.q: 前面堵车了，我们走小路___。
items.zh: 前面堵车了，我们走小路吧。
items.py: qián miàn dǔ chē le wǒ men zǒu xiǎo lù ba
items.en: There's a traffic jam ahead; let's take the side road.
items.why: The speaker is proposing a new route, so 吧. 吗 would ask whether we are taking it, and 呢 would not propose anything.

items.zh: 我喜欢吃饺子，你呢？
items.py: wǒ xǐ huan chī jiǎo zi nǐ ne
items.en: I like eating dumplings. What about you?
items.why: "And you?" is a bare pronoun + 呢 after the statement. 吗 cannot follow a bare 你.

items.q: 你们中秋节回不回老家___？
items.zh: 你们中秋节回不回老家？
items.py: nǐ men zhōng qiū jié huí bù huí lǎo jiā
items.en: Are you going back to your hometown for the Mid-Autumn Festival or not?
items.why: 回不回 is a verb-不-verb question already, so 吗 must be left out. Using both would ask the question twice.

items.q: 我猜你是北京人___？
items.zh: 我猜你是北京人吧？
items.py: wǒ cāi nǐ shì běi jīng rén ba
items.en: I guess you're from Beijing, right?
items.why: 我猜 says the speaker already believes it and wants confirmation: 吧. 吗 asks with no opinion, which clashes with 我猜.

items.q: 这些饺子应该是你包的___？
items.zh: 这些饺子应该是你包的吧？
items.py: zhè xiē jiǎo zi yīng gāi shì nǐ bāo de ba
items.en: You must have made these dumplings, right?
items.why: 应该 shows the speaker's inference, so the particle is 吧. 吗 would ask with no expectation, which does not fit 应该.

items.q: 你别着急，客人一定会喜欢这道菜___。
items.zh: 你别着急，客人一定会喜欢这道菜的。
items.py: nǐ bié zháo jí kè rén yí dìng huì xǐ huan zhè dào cài de
items.en: Don't be anxious; the guests are sure to like this dish.
items.why: The reassurance 一定会...的 closes with 的. 了 would say they already came to like it, and 吗 would turn the reassurance into a question.

items.q: 我们家以前过年吃饺子，现在大家都不爱吃饺子___，改吃火锅了。
items.zh: 我们家以前过年吃饺子，现在大家都不爱吃饺子了，改吃火锅了。
items.py: wǒ men jiā yǐ qián guò nián chī jiǎo zi xiàn zài dà jia dōu bù ài chī jiǎo zi le gǎi chī huǒ guō le
items.en: Our family used to eat dumplings at New Year, but now nobody likes dumplings any more, so we have switched to hot pot.
items.why: 不爱吃...了 describes a change from before. 呢 would say they still do not like them, losing the contrast with 以前.

items.s: 你想吃就吃呗，不用问我。
items.s_py: nǐ xiǎng chī jiù chī bei bù yòng wèn wǒ
items.zh: 你想吃就吃呗，不用问我。
items.py: nǐ xiǎng chī jiù chī bei bù yòng wèn wǒ
items.en: If you want to eat, just eat. You don't have to ask me.
items.why: 想...就...呗 tells the listener to just do it. It is casual but correct.

items.s_py: wǒ xǐ huan chī là de nǐ ma
items.zh: 我喜欢吃辣的，你呢？
items.py: wǒ xǐ huan chī là de nǐ ne
items.en: I like spicy food. What about you?
items.why: Bouncing the question back is pronoun + 呢. 吗 needs a full statement before it.

items.q: 时间不早了，大家别喝了，早点回家休息___。
items.zh: 时间不早了，大家别喝了，早点回家休息吧。
items.py: shí jiān bù zǎo le dà jia bié hē le zǎo diǎn huí jiā xiū xī ba
items.en: It's getting late; no more drinking, everyone. Go home and rest.
items.why: This is a mild command to a group, softened by 吧. 吗 would ask whether they will go home.

items.q: 今天是除夕___，当然要吃团圆饭。
items.zh: 今天是除夕嘛，当然要吃团圆饭。
items.py: jīn tiān shì chú xī ma dāng rán yào chī tuán yuán fàn
items.en: It's New Year's Eve, after all, so of course we have the reunion dinner.
items.why: The speaker points to something obvious: 嘛, supported by 当然. 吗 would ask whether it is New Year's Eve.

items.q: 月饼本来就是甜的___，你怕甜就别买。
items.zh: 月饼本来就是甜的嘛，你怕甜就别买。
items.py: yuè bǐng běn lái jiù shì tián de ma nǐ pà tián jiù bié mǎi
items.en: Mooncakes are sweet by nature, you know; if you can't stand sweet things, don't buy them.
items.why: 本来就 marks a fact that should be obvious, and 嘛 reminds the listener. 吗 would ask whether they are sweet.

items.s: 放心，我不会告诉妈妈你偷吃了月饼的。
items.s_py: fàng xīn wǒ bú huì gào su mā ma nǐ tōu chī le yuè bǐng de
items.zh: 放心，我不会告诉妈妈你偷吃了月饼的。
items.py: fàng xīn wǒ bú huì gào su mā ma nǐ tōu chī le yuè bǐng de
items.en: Don't worry, I won't tell Mum that you sneaked a mooncake.
items.why: 不会...的 closes the promise. The 了 inside is verb-了 for 偷吃, so the final 的 is still right.

items.q: 今天的饺子真好吃___！
items.zh: 今天的饺子真好吃啊！
items.py: jīn tiān de jiǎo zi zhēn hǎo chī a
items.en: These dumplings are so good today!
items.why: 真好吃 is an exclamation, and 啊 adds the warmth. 吗 would turn it into a yes/no question.

items.task: Say he is in the middle of it (在 ... 呢).
items.zh: 他在吃年夜饭呢。
items.py: tā zài chī nián yè fàn ne
items.en: He's having the New Year's Eve dinner.
items.why: 在 + verb + 呢 shows the action in progress right now.

items.zh: 外面还下着大雪呢。
items.py: wài miàn hái xià zhe dà xuě ne
items.en: It is still snowing heavily outside.
items.why: 还 comes before 下着 and 呢 closes the sentence. 了 would announce that snow had just started.

items.s: 今天是中秋节吗，大家当然要吃月饼。
items.s_py: jīn tiān shì zhōng qiū jié ma dà jia dāng rán yào chī yuè bǐng
items.zh: 今天是中秋节嘛，大家当然要吃月饼。
items.py: jīn tiān shì zhōng qiū jié ma dà jia dāng rán yào chī yuè bǐng
items.en: It's Mid-Autumn Festival, after all, so of course everyone eats mooncakes.
items.why: The speaker states something obvious, which is 嘛. 吗 would turn the first clause into a question, which clashes with 当然.

items.q: 你放心吧，这家店的鱼是新鲜的，不会有问题___。
items.zh: 你放心吧，这家店的鱼是新鲜的，不会有问题的。
items.py: nǐ fàng xīn ba zhè jiā diàn de yú shì xīn xiān de bú huì yǒu wèn tí de
items.en: Rest assured, the fish at this restaurant is fresh; there will be no problem.
items.why: 不会有问题的 reassures. 吗 would turn it into a question, and 了 would claim a problem has appeared.

items.s_py: nǐ xiān zuò xià chī fàn ba ma
items.zh: 你先坐下吃饭吧。
items.py: nǐ xiān zuò xià chī fàn ba
items.en: Sit down and eat first.
items.why: A soft command takes 吧 alone. Stacking 吗 after it is never correct.

items.q: 我的月饼___？谁拿走了？
items.zh: 我的月饼呢？谁拿走了？
items.py: wǒ de yuè bǐng ne shuí ná zǒu le
items.en: Where is my mooncake? Who took it?
items.why: A noun + 呢 with no earlier question asks "where is it?". 吗 after a bare noun is not possible.

items.s_py: nǐ yīng gāi bù chī là ba
items.zh: 你应该不吃辣吧？
items.py: nǐ yīng gāi bù chī là ba
items.en: You don't eat spicy food, I suppose?
items.why: 吧 on a negative statement still shows a guess seeking agreement, and 应该 supports it.

items.q: 你们都不想动手，那好___，今晚的年夜饭我来做。
items.zh: 你们都不想动手，那好吧，今晚的年夜饭我来做。
items.py: nǐ men dōu bù xiǎng dòng shǒu nà hǎo ba jīn wǎn de nián yè fàn wǒ lái zuò
items.en: None of you wants to lift a finger. All right then, I'll cook tonight's New Year's Eve dinner.
items.why: 好吧 gives in reluctantly: "all right then". 好吗 would ask for approval, which is the opposite direction.

items.s_py: nǐ dào dǐ xiǎng chī shén me ne
items.zh: 你到底想吃什么呢？
items.py: nǐ dào dǐ xiǎng chī shén me ne
items.en: So what do you actually want to eat?
items.why: 呢 can sit on a question-word question and press for an answer, especially with 到底. It is natural and correct.

items.q: 饺子当然好吃___，这是妈妈做的。
items.zh: 饺子当然好吃嘛，这是妈妈做的。
items.py: jiǎo zi dāng rán hǎo chī ma zhè shì mā ma zuò de
items.en: Of course the dumplings are good; Mum made them.
items.why: 嘛 says "obviously, as you should know". 吗 would turn the statement into a question, and 吧 into a guess.

items.q: 既然你不爱吃月饼，那我们送给邻居___。
items.zh: 既然你不爱吃月饼，那我们送给邻居吧。
items.py: jì rán nǐ bù ài chī yuè bǐng nà wǒ men sòng gěi lín ju ba
items.en: Since you don't like mooncakes, let's give them to the neighbours.
items.why: A proposal for what to do next is 吧. 了 would say we have already given them away, which clashes with 既然.

items.q: 我一直没想明白，你觉得在饭馆吃年夜饭比在家做更方便___？
items.zh: 我一直没想明白，你觉得在饭馆吃年夜饭比在家做更方便吗？
items.py: wǒ yì zhí méi xiǎng míng bái nǐ jué de zài fàn guǎn chī nián yè fàn bǐ zài jiā zuò gèng fāng biàn ma
items.en: I have never been able to work it out: do you think eating the New Year's Eve dinner at a restaurant is more convenient than cooking at home?
items.why: The speaker states no opinion and asks for the listener's view, so a plain yes/no question needs 吗. 吧 would say the speaker already thinks so.

items.q: 快来___，月饼都要被吃光了！
items.zh: 快来啊，月饼都要被吃光了！
items.py: kuài lái a yuè bǐng dōu yào bèi chī guāng le
items.en: Come on, hurry, the mooncakes are about to be all eaten!
items.why: Friendly urging takes 啊. 吗 would turn it into a question, which does not fit the urgent tone.

items.s: 我才不想去那家饭馆呢。
items.s_py: wǒ cái bù xiǎng qù nà jiā fàn guǎn ne
items.zh: 我才不想去那家饭馆呢。
items.py: wǒ cái bù xiǎng qù nà jiā fàn guǎn ne
items.en: I'm certainly not going to that restaurant.
items.why: 才不...呢 is a strong refusal. 呢 after a negative statement is correct.

items.q: 我还没吃年夜饭___。
items.zh: 我还没吃年夜饭呢。
items.py: wǒ hái méi chī nián yè fàn ne
items.en: I haven't had New Year's Eve dinner yet.
items.why: 还没 means nothing has changed yet, so 了 cannot appear. 呢 marks "still the case". 吗 would turn it into a question.

items.q: 我早就跟你说过这家店要提前订位子___，你偏不听。
items.zh: 我早就跟你说过这家店要提前订位子嘛，你偏不听。
items.py: wǒ zǎo jiù gēn nǐ shuō guò zhè jiā diàn yào tí qián dìng wèi zi ma nǐ piān bù tīng
items.en: I told you long ago this place needs a reservation, but you wouldn't listen.
items.why: The speaker complains about something that was obvious: 嘛. 吗 would turn it into a question and spoil the complaint.

items.q: 这个灯笼多漂亮___！
items.zh: 这个灯笼多漂亮啊！
items.py: zhè ge dēng lóng duō piào liang a
items.en: How pretty this lantern is!
items.why: 多...啊 is an exclamation. 吗 would make it a yes/no question and 吧 would make it a guess.

items.q: 饿了，我们去吃火锅___。
items.zh: 饿了，我们去吃火锅吧。
items.py: è le wǒ men qù chī huǒ guō ba
items.en: I'm hungry; let's go and have hot pot.
items.why: A proposal to do something together takes 吧. 吗 would ask "are we going for hot pot?", which is not what the English says.

items.q: 你们两家人每年都一起吃年夜饭，关系应该很好___？
items.zh: 你们两家人每年都一起吃年夜饭，关系应该很好吧？
items.py: nǐ men liǎng jiā rén měi nián dōu yì qǐ chī nián yè fàn guān xi yīng gāi hěn hǎo ba
items.en: The two families have New Year's Eve dinner together every year, so you must be close, I suppose?
items.why: 应该 shows an inference seeking confirmation: 吧. 了 would announce a change, and 吗 would ask with no inference.

items.q: 大家都吃得这么高兴，今天的菜大概很合你们的口味___。
items.zh: 大家都吃得这么高兴，今天的菜大概很合你们的口味吧。
items.py: dà jia dōu chī de zhè me gāo xìng jīn tiān de cài dà gài hěn hé nǐ men de kǒu wèi ba
items.en: Everyone is eating so happily; the dishes today probably suit your taste, I suppose.
items.why: 大概 marks a guess seeking agreement: 吧. 了 would say the taste has newly changed, which is not the point.

items.q: 他今年大概不回来吃团圆饭了___。
items.zh: 他今年大概不回来吃团圆饭了吧。
items.py: tā jīn nián dà gài bù huí lái chī tuán yuán fàn le ba
items.en: He probably isn't coming back for the reunion dinner this year, I suppose.
items.why: 大概 marks a guess, so 吧 follows the sentence-final 了. 吗 would ask neutrally and does not combine with 大概.

items.q: 我已经不饿___，谢谢你。
items.zh: 我已经不饿了，谢谢你。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng bù è le xiè xiè nǐ
items.en: I'm not hungry any more, thank you.
items.why: 已经 + 不 means a change from before, so 了 is required. 呢 would mean "still", the opposite.

items.task: Turn it into a yes/no question.
items.zh: 你想吃饺子吗？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng chī jiǎo zi ma
items.en: Do you want to eat dumplings?
items.why: Add 吗 at the end of the statement; nothing else moves.

items.q: 爸爸还在厨房里做菜___。
items.zh: 爸爸还在厨房里做菜呢。
items.py: bà ba hái zài chú fáng lǐ zuò cài ne
items.en: Dad is still in the kitchen cooking.
items.why: 还在 shows he has not stopped, so 呢 marks the continuing state. 了 would say he has finished or changed.

items.q: 你一直没告诉我，这个月饼是你自己做的___？
items.zh: 你一直没告诉我，这个月饼是你自己做的吗？
items.py: nǐ yì zhí méi gào sù wǒ zhè ge yuè bǐng shì nǐ zì jǐ zuò de ma
items.en: You never told me. Did you make this mooncake yourself?
items.why: The speaker had no idea beforehand and asks neutrally: 吗. 呢 cannot turn a statement into a yes/no question, and 了 cannot close a question like this.

items.q: 天黑___，饭馆里的灯都亮起来了。
items.zh: 天黑了，饭馆里的灯都亮起来了。
items.py: tiān hēi le fàn guǎn lǐ de dēng dōu liàng qǐ lái le
items.en: It's dark now; the lights in the restaurant have all come on.
items.why: The sky has become dark, a change of state: 了. 呢 would mean it is still getting dark.

items.s_py: nǐ shì nǎ li rén ba
items.zh: 你是哪里人？
items.py: nǐ shì nǎ li rén
items.en: Where are you from?
items.why: 哪里 asks for information, so no 吧 can be added.

items.q: 放心，明天一定会有位子___。
items.zh: 放心，明天一定会有位子的。
items.py: fàng xīn míng tiān yí dìng huì yǒu wèi zi de
items.en: Rest assured, there will definitely be a table tomorrow.
items.why: 一定会...的 is an assurance about tomorrow. 了 does not fit a future event, and 吗 would turn the promise into a question.

items.q: 今天是你的生日，来，许个愿___。
items.zh: 今天是你的生日，来，许个愿吧。
items.py: jīn tiān shì nǐ de shēng rì lái xǔ gè yuàn ba
items.en: It's your birthday. Come on, make a wish.
items.why: An encouraging soft command takes 吧. 吗 would ask whether the listener makes a wish.

items.s_py: jiǎo zi hǎo chī bù hǎo chī ma
items.zh: 饺子好吃不好吃？
items.py: jiǎo zi hǎo chī bù hǎo chī
items.en: Are the dumplings good?
items.why: 好吃不好吃 is already a question, so 吗 cannot be added.

items.s_py: wǒ hái méi chī yuè bǐng le
items.zh: 我还没吃月饼呢。
items.py: wǒ hái méi chī yuè bǐng ne
items.en: I haven't eaten a mooncake yet.
items.why: 还没 means nothing has changed yet, so 了 is impossible. The particle for "still the case" is 呢.

items.q: 你别以为大家都吃完了，我们这桌的菜还没上齐___。
items.zh: 你别以为大家都吃完了，我们这桌的菜还没上齐呢。
items.py: nǐ bié yǐ wéi dà jia dōu chī wán le wǒ men zhè zhuō de cài hái méi shàng qí ne
items.en: Don't think everyone has finished; the dishes at our table aren't all out yet.
items.why: 还没 means the situation has not changed, so 了 is impossible. 呢 corrects the listener's assumption that it is all over.

items.q: 今年过年，我们去奶奶家___。
items.zh: 今年过年，我们去奶奶家吧。
items.py: jīn nián guò nián wǒ men qù nǎi nai jiā ba
items.en: Let's go to Grandma's for New Year this year.
items.why: The cue is a proposal, which is 吧. 吗 would ask "Are we going to Grandma's?" instead of suggesting it.

items.q: 别怕，这个汤不会很辣___。
items.zh: 别怕，这个汤不会很辣的。
items.py: bié pà zhè ge tāng bú huì hěn là de
items.en: Don't be afraid; this soup won't be very spicy.
items.why: 不会...的 gives calm reassurance. 吗 would turn the promise into a question, and 了 would announce a change.

items.q: 难得一家人能坐在一起吃年夜饭，真热闹___！
items.zh: 难得一家人能坐在一起吃年夜饭，真热闹啊！
items.py: nán dé yī jiā rén néng zuò zài yì qǐ chī nián yè fàn zhēn rè nao a
items.en: It is rare for the whole family to sit down together for New Year's Eve dinner. How lively it is!
items.why: 真热闹 is an exclamation with warmth: 啊. 吗 would make it a question and 吧 a guess.

items.q: 你到底吃不吃辣___？
items.zh: 你到底吃不吃辣呢？
items.py: nǐ dào dǐ chī bù chī là ne
items.en: So do you eat spicy food or not?
items.why: 吃不吃 is already a question, so 吗 is out. 呢 can follow it to press for an answer. 吧 would guess an answer instead.

items.src_py: wǒ xǐ huan chī là de
items.task: Say you no longer like it (not any more).
items.zh: 我不喜欢吃辣的了。
items.py: wǒ bù xǐ huan chī là de le
items.en: I don't like spicy food any more.
items.why: 不...了 expresses "not any more": 了 is added at the end.

items.q: 是___，我也觉得妈妈做的菜最好吃。
items.zh: 是啊，我也觉得妈妈做的菜最好吃。
items.py: shì a wǒ yě jué de mā ma zuò de cài zuì hǎo chī
items.en: Yes, exactly, I think Mum's cooking is the best too.
items.why: 是啊 is warm agreement. 是吗 means "Really?", which is the opposite of agreeing.

items.q: 你去哪儿___？我们一起吃饭吧。
items.zh: 你去哪儿啊？我们一起吃饭吧。
items.py: nǐ qù nǎ r a wǒ men yì qǐ chī fàn ba
items.en: Where are you off to? Let's eat together.
items.why: 啊 can make a question-word question friendlier. 吗 and 吧 cannot follow 哪儿.

items.q: 明天中秋节，你们公司肯定放假___？
items.zh: 明天中秋节，你们公司肯定放假吧？
items.py: míng tiān zhōng qiū jié nǐ men gōng sī kěn dìng fàng jià ba
items.en: Tomorrow is Mid-Autumn; your company surely has the day off, right?
items.why: 肯定 means the speaker is almost sure and wants agreement: 吧. 吗 would show no opinion at all.

items.q: 这些饺子是猪肉的，那牛肉的___？
items.zh: 这些饺子是猪肉的，那牛肉的呢？
items.py: zhè xiē jiǎo zi shì zhū ròu de nà niú ròu de ne
items.en: These dumplings are pork. What about the beef ones?
items.why: Comparing a new item with the one just discussed is noun + 呢. 吗 cannot follow a noun phrase on its own.

items.s_py: nǐ xiǎng hē shén me tāng ma
items.zh: 你想喝什么汤？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng hē shén me tāng
items.en: What soup do you want?
items.why: 什么 already asks for information, so 吗 cannot follow it.

items.q: 我才不吃那么辣的菜___！
items.zh: 我才不吃那么辣的菜呢！
items.py: wǒ cái bù chī nà me là de cài ne
items.en: I'm certainly not eating food that spicy!
items.why: 才不...呢 is a strong refusal: the 才 pushes back and 呢 closes it. 了 would mean "not any more", and 吧 would soften it into a suggestion.

items.zh: 我们去饭馆吃饺子吧。
items.py: wǒ men qù fàn guǎn chī jiǎo zi ba
items.en: Let's go to a restaurant and eat dumplings.
items.why: 吧 goes at the very end to make the suggestion. 吗 would ask a question instead.

items.q: 放心，我不会忘了买月饼___。
items.zh: 放心，我不会忘了买月饼的。
items.py: fàng xīn wǒ bú huì wàng le mǎi yuè bǐng de
items.en: Don't worry, I won't forget to buy the mooncakes.
items.why: The speaker promises with 不会...的. 吗 would turn the promise into a question, and a final 了 would claim a new situation.

items.q: 我们怎么去饭馆___？
items.zh: 我们怎么去饭馆呢？
items.py: wǒ men zěn me qù fàn guǎn ne
items.en: So how are we getting to the restaurant?
items.why: 怎么 already asks the question, so 吗 is impossible. 呢 is the particle that can sit on a question-word question and make it sound thoughtful.

items.q: 饭好___，快来吃吧。
items.zh: 饭好了，快来吃吧。
items.py: fàn hǎo le kuài lái chī ba
items.en: The meal is ready; come and eat.
items.why: The food has just become ready, a new situation: 了. 呢 would suggest it is still being cooked.

items.s_py: nǐ xiǎng hē diǎn shén me ma
items.zh: 你想喝点什么吗？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng hē diǎn shén me ma
items.en: Would you like something to drink?
items.why: Here 什么 means "something", not a question word, so the sentence is a yes/no question and 吗 is correct.

items.task: Add 一定 and an assuring final particle.
items.zh: 他一定会来的。
items.py: tā yí dìng huì lái de
items.en: He will definitely come.
items.why: 一定会...的 is the assurance pattern; the sentence ends with 的.

items.q: 我现在不吃辣___，医生不让我吃。
items.zh: 我现在不吃辣了，医生不让我吃。
items.py: wǒ xiàn zài bù chī là le yī sheng bù ràng wǒ chī
items.en: I don't eat spicy food any more; the doctor won't let me.
items.why: 不...了 means "not any more". 呢 would say the situation is unchanged.

items.q: 我们不太熟，你们过年吃饺子___？
items.zh: 我们不太熟，你们过年吃饺子吗？
items.py: wǒ men bù tài shú nǐ men guò nián chī jiǎo zi ma
items.en: We don't know each other well. Do you eat dumplings at New Year?
items.why: The speaker has no guess about their habits, so this is a neutral yes/no question: 吗. 吧 would mean 'you eat dumplings, I take it?', which the context rules out.

items.q: 我不想吃饺子___，换个别的吧。
items.zh: 我不想吃饺子了，换个别的吧。
items.py: wǒ bù xiǎng chī jiǎo zi le huàn gè bié de ba
items.en: I don't feel like dumplings any more; let's have something else.
items.why: 不想...了 says the wish has changed. 呢 would say it is still the case.

items.q: 现在才六点___，饭馆还没开门。
items.zh: 现在才六点呢，饭馆还没开门。
items.py: xiàn zài cái liù diǎn ne fàn guǎn hái méi kāi mén
items.en: It's only six o'clock; the restaurant isn't open yet.
items.why: 才 says it is earlier than expected, and 呢 closes that "still early" statement. 了 would claim a new situation and clashes with 才.

items.q: 别哭，下次你一定会吃到___。
items.zh: 别哭，下次你一定会吃到的。
items.py: bié kū xià cì nǐ yí dìng huì chī dào de
items.en: Don't cry; you'll definitely get some next time.
items.why: 一定会 plus final 的 is a firm promise about the future. 了 reports a change, and 吗 would turn the promise into a question.

items.q: 他正在包饺子___，你等一会儿再打电话吧。
items.zh: 他正在包饺子呢，你等一会儿再打电话吧。
items.py: tā zhèng zài bāo jiǎo zi ne nǐ děng yī huì r zài dǎ diàn huà ba
items.en: He's wrapping dumplings right now; wait a bit before you call.
items.why: 正在 + verb shows an action in progress and takes 呢 at the end. 了 would turn it into a completed event, which clashes with 正在.

items.q: 餐厅今天没有鱼，明天___？
items.zh: 餐厅今天没有鱼，明天呢？
items.py: cān tīng jīn tiān méi yǒu yú míng tiān ne
items.en: The restaurant has no fish today. What about tomorrow?
items.why: "What about X?" after a negative answer is noun + 呢. 吗 would need a whole statement such as 明天有鱼吗.

items.s: 放心，我一定会请你吃饭了。
items.s_py: fàng xīn wǒ yí dìng huì qǐng nǐ chī fàn le
items.zh: 放心，我一定会请你吃饭的。
items.py: fàng xīn wǒ yí dìng huì qǐng nǐ chī fàn de
items.en: Rest assured, I will definitely treat you to dinner.
items.why: A promise about the future is 会...的. 了 reports a change, which does not fit 一定会.

items.q: 你想喝酒就喝___，反正今天过节。
items.zh: 你想喝酒就喝呗，反正今天过节。
items.py: nǐ xiǎng hē jiǔ jiù hē bei fǎn zhèng jīn tiān guò jié
items.en: If you want a drink, just have one; it's a holiday anyway.
items.why: 想...就... plus 呗 means "just do it, no big deal". 吗 would turn the sentence into a question, which the shrugging tone rules out.

items.q: 你先喝点汤___，菜马上就来。
items.zh: 你先喝点汤吧，菜马上就来。
items.py: nǐ xiān hē diǎn tāng ba cài mǎ shàng jiù lái
items.en: Why don't you have some soup first; the dishes are coming right up.
items.why: A gentle invitation to do something is a soft command with 吧. 吗 would ask a factual question.

items.q: 这么贵的菜，味道应该不错___。
items.zh: 这么贵的菜，味道应该不错吧。
items.py: zhè me guì de cài wèi dào yīng gāi bù cuò ba
items.en: Food this expensive should taste pretty good, I suppose.
items.why: 应该 plus a guess about the taste takes 吧. 吗 would ask a question, and 呢 would state something is still the case.

items.q: 过节___，吃得多一点有什么关系，明天再减肥。
items.zh: 过节嘛，吃得多一点有什么关系，明天再减肥。
items.py: guò jié ma chī de duō yì diǎn yǒu shén me guān xi míng tiān zài jiǎn féi
items.en: It's a holiday, after all; what's wrong with eating a bit more? Diet tomorrow.
items.why: 嘛 gives the obvious reason that excuses the speaker. 吗 would make the first clause a question.

items.q: 这家店的人太多了，我们换一家饭馆___，不然要等一个小时。
items.zh: 这家店的人太多了，我们换一家饭馆吧，不然要等一个小时。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn de rén tài duō le wǒ men huàn yī jiā fàn guǎn ba bù rán yào děng yí gè xiǎo shí
items.en: This place is too crowded; let's switch to another restaurant, or we'll wait an hour.
items.why: The speaker proposes a plan, so 吧. 了 would report that we already switched, and 吗 would ask a question.

items.q: 你想吃什么___？
items.zh: 你想吃什么？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng chī shén me
items.en: What do you want to eat?
items.why: 什么 already makes this a question asking for information, so nothing is added. 吗 is only for turning a statement into a yes/no question.

items.s_py: jīn tiān de cài zhēn hǎo chī ma
items.zh: 今天的菜真好吃啊！
items.py: jīn tiān de cài zhēn hǎo chī a
items.en: Today's food is so good!
items.why: 真好吃 is an exclamation, and 吗 would make it a question. 啊 adds warmth.

items.s: 你们几点去吃团圆饭吗？
items.s_py: nǐ men jǐ diǎn qù chī tuán yuán fàn ma
items.zh: 你们几点去吃团圆饭？
items.py: nǐ men jǐ diǎn qù chī tuán yuán fàn
items.en: What time are you going to the reunion dinner?
items.why: 几点 asks for information, so 吗 cannot follow it.

items.q: 为什么大家过中秋节都要吃月饼___？
items.zh: 为什么大家过中秋节都要吃月饼呢？
items.py: wèi shén me dà jia guò zhōng qiū jié dōu yào chī yuè bǐng ne
items.en: Why does everybody eat mooncakes at Mid-Autumn, I wonder?
items.why: 为什么 makes the sentence a question, so 吗 cannot be used. 呢 makes a why-question sound curious and less blunt.

items.q: 孩子们都长大___，不再跟着大人去逛庙会了。
items.zh: 孩子们都长大了，不再跟着大人去逛庙会了。
items.py: hái zi men dōu zhǎng dà le bù zài gēn zhe dà rén qù guàng miào huì le
items.en: The children have all grown up and no longer follow the grown-ups to the temple fair.
items.why: 长大了 is a change: they are grown now. 呢 would suggest they are still growing up, which clashes with 不再.

items.q: 不想做饭就出去吃___。
items.zh: 不想做饭就出去吃呗。
items.py: bù xiǎng zuò fàn jiù chū qù chī bei
items.en: If you don't feel like cooking, just eat out, then.
items.why: ...就...呗 treats the answer as simple, with a shrug. 吗 would ask a question and 呢 would say the situation is still going on.

items.s_py: wǒ bù xiǎng chī le nǐ chī ba
items.zh: 我不想吃了，你吃吧。
items.py: wǒ bù xiǎng chī le nǐ chī ba
items.en: I don't want to eat any more; you go ahead.
items.why: 不想吃了 means a changed wish, and 吧 softly offers the food. Both particles are correct.

items.q: 今年春节你不回来，爸妈一定会想你___，记得多打电话。
items.zh: 今年春节你不回来，爸妈一定会想你的，记得多打电话。
items.py: jīn nián chūn jié nǐ bù huí lái bà mā yí dìng huì xiǎng nǐ de jì de duō dǎ diàn huà
items.en: If you don't come home this Spring Festival, Mum and Dad are bound to miss you; remember to call often.
items.why: 一定会 plus 的 is a confident prediction. 了 would announce that they now miss you, and 吗 would turn it into a question.

items.q: 她才五岁___，你别让她吃那么辣的菜。
items.zh: 她才五岁嘛，你别让她吃那么辣的菜。
items.py: tā cái wǔ suì ma nǐ bié ràng tā chī nà me là de cài
items.en: She's only five, after all; don't let her eat food that spicy.
items.why: The speaker is stating the obvious reason, which is 嘛. 吗 would ask whether she is five.

items.q: 别关门，里面还有客人在吃饭___。
items.zh: 别关门，里面还有客人在吃饭呢。
items.py: bié guān mén lǐ miàn hái yǒu kè rén zài chī fàn ne
items.en: Don't close up; there are still guests eating inside.
items.why: 在 + verb marks an action in progress, and 呢 confirms it is still the case. 了 would announce a change, and 吗 would turn it into a question.

items.q: 烟花还没放___，大家再等一会儿，十二点才开始。
items.zh: 烟花还没放呢，大家再等一会儿，十二点才开始。
items.py: yān huā hái méi fàng ne dà jia zài děng yī huì r shí èr diǎn cái kāi shǐ
items.en: The fireworks haven't started yet; wait a little longer, they only begin at twelve.
items.why: 还没 + 呢 says "not yet, still waiting". 了 cannot go after 还没, and 吗 would ask a question instead of reassuring.

items.q: 如果我们十二个人都想在除夕吃火锅，这家店能订到位子___？
items.zh: 如果我们十二个人都想在除夕吃火锅，这家店能订到位子吗？
items.py: rú guǒ wǒ men shí èr gè rén dōu xiǎng zài chú xī chī huǒ guō zhè jiā diàn néng dìng dào wèi zi ma
items.en: If all twelve of us want hot pot on New Year's Eve, can this place book us a table?
items.why: No question word, no A-not-A and no 还是: a neutral yes/no question ends in 吗. 呢 cannot turn a statement into a yes/no question.

items.zh: 他一定会喜欢这道菜的。
items.py: tā yí dìng huì xǐ huan zhè dào cài de
items.en: He will definitely like this dish.
items.why: 一定会...的 gives the assurance, with 的 at the end. 了 would report a change.

items.q: 你一定饿了___？
items.zh: 你一定饿了吧？
items.py: nǐ yí dìng è le ba
items.en: You must be hungry, right?
items.why: 一定 expresses certainty, so the sentence is a guess seeking agreement: 吧. 吗 does not combine with 一定.

items.q: 相信我，这家饭馆的菜不会让你失望___。
items.zh: 相信我，这家饭馆的菜不会让你失望的。
items.py: xiāng xin wǒ zhè jiā fàn guǎn de cài bú huì ràng nǐ shī wàng de
items.en: Trust me, the food at this restaurant won't let you down.
items.why: 不会...的 reassures the listener. 了 would claim they are already disappointed, and 吗 would turn the promise into a question.

items.q: 年夜饭以后，你们喝茶还是喝酒___？
items.zh: 年夜饭以后，你们喝茶还是喝酒？
items.py: nián yè fàn yǐ hòu nǐ men hē chá hái shi hē jiǔ
items.en: After the New Year's Eve dinner, will you drink tea or alcohol?
items.why: 还是 asks the listener to choose between two options, which makes the sentence a question already. 吗 cannot be added.

items.q: 她现在是一家饭馆的老板___，生意不错。
items.zh: 她现在是一家饭馆的老板了，生意不错。
items.py: tā xiàn zài shì yī jiā fàn guǎn de lǎo ban le shēng yi bù cuò
items.en: She's the owner of a restaurant now, and business is good.
items.why: 现在 + 是 + 了 marks the new status. 的 would not mark a change, and 吧 would be a guess.

items.s_py: kuài lái a jiǎo zi dōu yào liáng le
items.zh: 快来啊，饺子都要凉了！
items.py: kuài lái a jiǎo zi dōu yào liáng le
items.en: Come on, hurry, the dumplings are about to get cold!
items.why: 啊 is friendly urging here. 啊 can follow a command, which learners may doubt.

items.src_py: wǒ men qù fàn guǎn chī fàn
items.task: Turn it into a suggestion ("Let's...").
items.zh: 我们去饭馆吃饭吧。
items.py: wǒ men qù fàn guǎn chī fàn ba
items.en: Let's go to a restaurant to eat.
items.why: 吧 at the end turns a statement into a suggestion.

items.s_py: wǒ yǐ jīng bù ài chī jiǎo zi
items.zh: 我已经不爱吃饺子了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng bù ài chī jiǎo zi le
items.en: I don't like dumplings any more.
items.why: 已经 with 不 describes a change, so 了 is needed at the end.

items.q: 没想到你还会做这么复杂的菜，你真厉害___！
items.zh: 没想到你还会做这么复杂的菜，你真厉害啊！
items.py: méi xiǎng dào nǐ hái huì zuò zhè me fù zá de cài nǐ zhēn lì hai a
items.en: I had no idea you could cook such a complicated dish. You're amazing!
items.why: An admiring exclamation with 真 takes 啊. 吗 would turn the praise into a question.

items.zh: 今天是中秋节嘛。
items.py: jīn tiān shì zhōng qiū jié ma
items.en: It's Mid-Autumn Festival today, after all.
items.why: 嘛 closes a statement of the obvious. 吗 would turn it into a question.

items.q: 你们今年大概也在家过年___？
items.zh: 你们今年大概也在家过年吧？
items.py: nǐ men jīn nián dà gài yě zài jiā guò nián ba
items.en: You're probably staying home for New Year this year too, I suppose?
items.why: 大概 means "probably", which signals a guess seeking agreement: 吧. 吗 would be a neutral question with no guess.

items.s_py: xíng ba nà jiù zài jiā chī huǒ guō
items.zh: 行吧，那就在家吃火锅。
items.py: xíng ba nà jiù zài jiā chī huǒ guō
items.en: All right then, let's have hot pot at home.
items.why: 行吧 gives in to a proposal, so 吧 is correct. It looks like a question, but it is not.
